name: Construction: civil works & site
description: Everyday New Zealand civil construction words: earthworks, roads, three waters pipes, concrete and structures, survey, safety, traffic management and site talk.

words.zh: 土木工程（设计和建造道路、桥梁、管网等）
words.definition: The branch of engineering that designs and builds roads, bridges, pipes, dams and other public works.

examples.en: She studied civil engineering and now designs stormwater networks.
examples.zh: 她学的是土木工程，现在设计雨水管网。

words.zh: 土木工程施工（路、管道、土方等）
words.definition: The physical construction work on roads, pipes, earthworks and similar structures, as opposed to buildings.

examples.en: The civil works should be finished before the houses go up.
examples.zh: 土木工程应该在盖房子之前完成。

words.note: civil works 指“路、管、土方”这类施工，不是“民用”的意思；civil 在这里是“土木”。

words.zh: 土木承包商（做路、管、土方的施工公司）
words.definition: A company that builds roads, pipes, earthworks and other civil infrastructure for clients.

examples.en: Most civil contractors in the region are flat out with flood repairs.
examples.zh: 这个地区大多数土木承包商都在忙着做洪灾修复。

words.zh: 土方工程（挖土、填土、平整场地）
words.definition: Moving, cutting, filling and shaping the ground to the levels a design needs.

examples.en: Earthworks start in October once the ground dries out.
examples.zh: 等地面干了，土方工程十月开工。

words.note: 新西兰几乎总用复数 earthworks；季节性很强，通常夏季（earthworks season）才大规模干。

words.zh: 土方施工季（新西兰一般是夏半年）
words.definition: The drier months when councils and conditions allow large earthworks, usually spring to autumn in New Zealand.

examples.en: If we miss this earthworks season, the job slips a whole year.
examples.zh: 如果错过这个土方施工季，整个项目就要推迟一年。

words.note: 很多地区的资源许可在冬季限制或禁止大规模土方，所以工期安排常围绕这个季节。

words.zh: 基础设施
words.definition: The basic physical systems a community needs, such as roads, water pipes, power and telecommunications.

examples.en: The council is spending more on infrastructure after the floods.
examples.zh: 洪灾之后市政府加大了基础设施投入。

words.zh: 三水（饮用水、污水、雨水）
words.definition: New Zealand's name for the three public water services together: drinking water, wastewater and stormwater.

examples.en: We do a lot of three waters work for councils around the North Island.
examples.zh: 我们给北岛各地市政做大量三水工程。

words.note: 新西兰特有说法，指 drinking water + wastewater + stormwater 三套管网和设施。

words.zh: 饮用水（自来水供水系统）
words.definition: Treated water that is safe to drink, delivered to homes and businesses through the water supply network.

examples.en: The new drinking water main will run along the eastern side of the road.
examples.zh: 新的饮用水主管会沿着道路东侧铺设。

words.zh: 饮用水（正式工程用语）
words.definition: A formal word for water that is safe to drink, often used on drawings and in specifications.

examples.en: Potable water pipes must be kept well away from the sewer.
examples.zh: 饮用水管必须和污水管保持足够距离。

words.note: 图纸和规范上常写 potable water，口语多说 drinking water 或 water supply。

words.zh: 供水（供水系统）
words.definition: The system of treatment plants, reservoirs and pipes that delivers drinking water.

examples.en: The whole street will be off water supply for four hours tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天整条街会停水四个小时。

words.zh: 污水（生活和工业废水）
words.definition: Used water from toilets, sinks, showers and industry that goes through the sewer to a treatment plant.

examples.en: The wastewater line is about three metres deep at this end.
examples.zh: 污水管在这一头大约三米深。

words.note: wastewater 是正式说法，口语常说 sewer 或 sewage；不包括雨水。

words.zh: 雨水（地面雨水径流及排水系统）
words.definition: Rainwater that runs off roofs, roads and paved areas, and the pipes and channels that carry it away.

examples.en: Stormwater from the new carpark goes into a rain garden first.
examples.zh: 新停车场的雨水先流进雨水花园。

words.note: NZ 写成一个词 stormwater；雨水和污水在新西兰是两套分开的管网。

words.zh: 道路工程（修路和养路）
words.definition: New Zealand word for the work of building and maintaining roads.

examples.en: Our roading crew is resealing the rural roads this summer.
examples.zh: 我们的道路施工队今年夏天在给乡村道路重新封层。

words.note: 新西兰特有词；美式英语一般说 road construction / roadwork。

words.zh: 道路施工（施工路段）
words.definition: Work being done on a road, usually with cones, signs and traffic control in place.

examples.en: Expect delays through the roadworks on State Highway 2.
examples.zh: 经过2号国道施工路段时预计会有延误。

words.zh: 桥梁
words.definition: A structure that carries a road, railway or path over a river, valley or another road.

examples.en: The bridge is closed while we replace the deck joints.
examples.zh: 我们更换桥面伸缩缝期间桥梁封闭。

words.zh: 路面结构（工程用语，指所有路面层）
words.definition: In engineering, all the layers of a road built on the subgrade, from sub-base up to the surface.

examples.en: The pavement has failed because water got into the basecourse.
examples.zh: 路面坏了是因为水渗进了基层。

words.note: 工程里 pavement 指整个路面结构层；人行道在新西兰叫 footpath，不叫 pavement（英国口语里 pavement 才是人行道）。

words.zh: 修复改造（简称 rehab，把旧路或旧管道大修）
words.definition: Major repair that restores an old road or pipe to good condition, often by rebuilding its layers or lining it.

examples.en: This section of road is programmed for rehab next year.
examples.zh: 这一段路计划明年做大修。

words.note: 现场常简称 rehab（REE-hab），比如 pavement rehab、pipe rehab。

words.zh: 更新换新（旧设施到寿命后整体更换）
words.definition: Work that replaces old assets, such as pipes or road surfaces, that have reached the end of their life.

examples.en: Most of this year's budget is for water main renewals.
examples.zh: 今年大部分预算用于供水主管更新。

words.zh: 绿地项目（在从未开发过的土地上新建）
words.definition: Describes a project built on land that has never been developed, such as farmland.

examples.en: It's a greenfield subdivision, so there are no existing services to worry about.
examples.zh: 这是在空地上开发的分地项目，所以不用担心现有管线。

words.zh: 棕地项目（在已开发或旧场地上施工）
words.definition: Describes a project on land that has been used before, often with old services, buildings or contamination.

examples.en: Brownfield sites are slower because you keep finding old pipes.
examples.zh: 棕地项目进度慢，因为你会不断挖到旧管道。

words.note: IT 里也说 greenfield/brownfield（全新系统 vs 在旧系统上改），意思类似。

words.zh: 水平工程（道路、管道等横向延伸的工程）
words.definition: Construction that spreads out along the ground, such as roads, pipelines and railways.

examples.en: We're a horizontal construction company; we don't build houses.
examples.zh: 我们是做横向工程的公司，不盖房子。

words.note: 与 vertical construction（楼房建筑）相对。

words.zh: 竖向工程（楼房、建筑物）
words.definition: Construction of buildings and other structures that go upwards.

examples.en: Once the civil works are done, the vertical construction team takes over.
examples.zh: 土木工程完成后，由建筑施工团队接手。

words.zh: 分地开发（把大块地分成住宅地块并修路管）
words.definition: Dividing a large piece of land into smaller lots, and building the roads and services they need.

examples.en: The subdivision will have 120 lots and two new roads.
examples.zh: 这个分地开发项目会有120个地块和两条新路。

words.note: 新西兰的 subdivision 常指整个住宅开发区项目，而不只是“细分”这个动作。

words.zh: 地块（分地后的一块地）
words.definition: One numbered piece of land in a subdivision.

examples.en: The water connections for lots 1 to 30 are in.
examples.zh: 1到30号地块的供水接口已经装好。

words.note: 质量资料里 lot 还指“验收批次”（a lot of basecourse），按上下文区分。

words.zh: 土地开发
words.definition: Turning raw land into usable sites by adding roads, services and building platforms.

examples.en: Land development work is slowing down with higher interest rates.
examples.zh: 利率上升，土地开发工程在放缓。

words.zh: 建房平台（平整好可建房的地面）
words.definition: The flat, compacted area on a lot where a house can be built.

examples.en: The building platforms need geotech sign-off before we hand over.
examples.zh: 建房平台在移交前需要岩土工程师签字确认。

words.zh: 公用设施（水、电、气、通讯等管线）
words.definition: Services such as power, gas, water and telecommunications, and the cables and pipes that carry them.

examples.en: Coordinate with the utilities before we trench along the footpath.
examples.zh: 在人行道开沟前要先和各管线单位协调。

words.zh: 国道（新西兰国家公路）
words.definition: A main road in New Zealand managed by the national transport agency rather than a local council.

examples.en: The work on State Highway 1 has to be done at night.
examples.zh: 1号国道上的施工必须在夜间进行。

words.note: 常缩写为 SH，如 SH1、SH2；地方道路则由各市政府（council）管理。

words.zh: 地方道路（由市政管理的道路）
words.definition: A road managed by the local council rather than the national highway network.

examples.en: It's a local road, so the council is the road controlling authority.
examples.zh: 这是地方道路，所以道路管理机构是市政府。

words.zh: 高速公路
words.definition: A high-speed road with no direct property access and separate carriageways for each direction.

examples.en: The motorway widening needs new noise walls on both sides.
examples.zh: 高速公路拓宽需要在两侧新建隔音墙。

words.note: 新西兰/英国叫 motorway，美国叫 freeway / highway。

words.zh: 防洪堤（河边的土堤）
words.definition: An earth bank built along a river to stop it flooding the land behind.

examples.en: The stopbank was raised half a metre after the last flood.
examples.zh: 上次洪水后防洪堤加高了半米。

words.note: 新西兰特有词，相当于 levee / flood bank。

words.zh: 海堤（护岸墙）
words.definition: A wall built along the coast to protect land from waves and erosion.

examples.en: The seawall repairs can only happen at low tide.
examples.zh: 海堤维修只能在低潮时进行。

words.zh: 隧道
words.definition: An underground passage for a road, railway or pipe.

examples.en: The tunnel boring machine is due to break through next month.
examples.zh: 隧道掘进机预计下个月贯通。

words.zh: 抢修工程（灾后紧急修复）
words.definition: Urgent repairs after a storm, flood, slip or earthquake to make a road or service safe and open again.

examples.en: After the cyclone, half our crews were moved onto emergency works.
examples.zh: 飓风过后，我们一半的施工队被调去做抢修。

words.zh: 抗灾韧性（设施抵抗灾害、快速恢复的能力）
words.definition: How well a road, pipe or network can cope with floods, earthquakes and other events and recover quickly.

examples.en: The new bridge is about resilience; the old one keeps getting washed out.
examples.zh: 建新桥是为了抗灾，旧桥老是被冲毁。

words.zh: 净水厂（自来水处理厂）
words.definition: A facility that cleans raw water from rivers, lakes or bores so it is safe to drink.

examples.en: We're laying a new trunk main from the water treatment plant to the reservoir.
examples.zh: 我们在从净水厂到蓄水池之间铺设一条新的输水干管。

words.zh: 污水处理厂
words.definition: A facility that treats sewage before the cleaned water is released to a river, the sea or land.

examples.en: The wastewater treatment plant upgrade is a three-year project.
examples.zh: 污水处理厂升级是一个三年的项目。

words.zh: 蓄水池（供水系统的储水罐或水库）
words.definition: A large tank or lake that stores treated drinking water before it goes into the network.

examples.en: The new reservoir sits on the hill so water can gravity-feed the town.
examples.zh: 新蓄水池建在山上，这样水可以靠重力流到镇上。

words.zh: 临时工程（施工期间用的临时结构）
words.definition: Structures used only during construction, such as shoring, falsework, access roads and temporary bridges.

examples.en: The temporary works design for the shoring has to be checked by an engineer.
examples.zh: 支护的临时工程设计必须由工程师复核。

words.note: 与 permanent works（永久工程，最后留下来交付的部分）相对。

words.zh: 永久工程（最终交付留下的部分）
words.definition: The parts of a project that stay after construction finishes and are handed over to the client.

examples.en: The haul road is temporary; the culvert under it is part of the permanent works.
examples.zh: 施工便道是临时的，下面的涵洞属于永久工程。

words.zh: 前期准备工程（为主体施工做准备）
words.definition: Early work that prepares a site for the main project, such as clearing, service relocations and access roads.

examples.en: Enabling works start in March, and the main contract later in the year.
examples.zh: 前期准备工程三月开始，主体合同在年内晚些时候开始。

words.zh: 场地清理（清除植被、垃圾、旧构筑物）
words.definition: Removing vegetation, rubbish, fences and old structures from a site before construction.

examples.en: Site clearance found an old septic tank behind the shed.
examples.zh: 场地清理时在棚子后面发现了一个旧化粪池。

words.zh: 拆除
words.definition: Knocking down and removing buildings or structures.

examples.en: Demolition of the old bridge can't start until the new one is open.
examples.zh: 新桥通车之前不能拆除旧桥。

words.zh: 绿化景观工程
words.definition: Planting, topsoiling and finishing outdoor areas such as berms, reserves and rain gardens.

examples.en: Landscaping is the last thing before we hand the subdivision over.
examples.zh: 绿化是分地项目移交前的最后一项工作。

words.zh: 街景改造（人行道、绿化、街道设施一体改造）
words.definition: Upgrading the look and layout of a street, including footpaths, trees, lighting and seating.

examples.en: The town centre streetscape upgrade means the main street is one-way for six months.
examples.zh: 镇中心街景改造意味着主街要单向通行六个月。

words.zh: 移交给市政（开发商把建好的路和管网正式交给市政）
words.definition: The legal handover of new roads, pipes and reserves from a developer to the council, which then owns and maintains them.

examples.en: All the stormwater pipes in the subdivision will vest in the council.
examples.zh: 分地项目里所有雨水管都会移交给市政。

words.note: 新西兰常用 vest in council（归属市政）；移交前市政要检查并接收 as-built 资料。

words.zh: 公共工程
words.definition: Construction paid for by government or councils for public use, such as roads, bridges and water supply.

examples.en: Public works must meet the council's engineering standards.
examples.zh: 公共工程必须达到市政的工程标准。

words.zh: 挖填（高处挖下的土填到低处）
words.definition: Digging soil from high areas and placing it in low areas to create the design levels.

examples.en: The design balances cut and fill, so we shouldn't need to import much material.
examples.zh: 设计上挖填基本平衡，所以不需要外运进很多土。

words.zh: 挖方（需要挖掉的部分）
words.definition: An area where ground is dug out to bring it down to design level.

examples.en: We're in cut along this stretch, about two metres deep.
examples.zh: 这一段是挖方，大约挖两米深。

words.note: 现场说 in cut / in fill，表示这一处是要挖还是要填。

words.zh: 填方（填上并压实的土）
words.definition: Soil or rock placed and compacted to raise the ground to design level.

examples.en: The fill has to go down in layers and be tested as we go.
examples.zh: 填方要分层铺，并且边做边检测。

words.zh: 开挖（挖土；也指挖出的坑）
words.definition: Digging out soil or rock, or the hole that is left afterwards.

examples.en: Keep the excavation fenced off overnight.
examples.zh: 晚上要把基坑用围栏围起来。

words.zh: 大方量土方（场地大面积挖填平整）
words.definition: Large-scale cutting, filling and shaping of a whole site with big machines, before detailed work starts.

examples.en: Bulk earthworks should be done by Christmas, then the pipe crews move in.
examples.zh: 大方量土方圣诞前完成，然后管道队进场。

words.zh: 表土（最上层含有机质的黑土）
words.definition: The dark top layer of soil that contains organic matter and is good for plants but not for building on.

examples.en: Strip the topsoil and stockpile it for landscaping later.
examples.zh: 把表土剥离并堆起来，以后绿化用。

words.zh: 剥表土（施工前把表土刮走）
words.definition: Removing the topsoil from an area before earthworks, because it is too soft to build on.

examples.en: The topsoil strip on stage two starts Monday.
examples.zh: 二期剥表土周一开始。

words.note: strip 作动词：strip the topsoil；作名词：the strip。

words.zh: 底土（表土下面的土层）
words.definition: The layer of soil under the topsoil, usually firmer and with little organic matter.

examples.en: Once you get through the topsoil, the subsoil is a stiff yellow clay.
examples.zh: 挖过表土后，下面的底土是硬的黄黏土。

words.zh: 路基土（路面结构下面的原状或填筑土层）
words.definition: The natural or filled ground that a road pavement or slab is built on.

examples.en: The subgrade is too soft here; we'll need to undercut it.
examples.zh: 这里路基太软，需要超挖换填。

words.zh: 工程填土（受控分层压实并检测的填方）
words.definition: Fill placed in controlled layers, compacted and tested under an engineer's supervision so it can carry loads.

examples.en: The lots with more than a metre of engineered fill need a geotech report.
examples.zh: 填土超过一米的地块需要岩土报告。

words.zh: 硬质回填料（碎石等，用于垫层和临时道路）
words.definition: Crushed rock or gravel used to build up firm ground, such as under slabs, driveways or site roads.

examples.en: Put some hardfill down at the gate so the trucks don't get bogged.
examples.zh: 在大门口铺些碎石，免得卡车陷进去。

words.note: 新西兰常用说法，泛指碎石类回填料，具体规格要看图纸。

words.zh: 清洁填料（无污染的土石，可去 cleanfill 场倾倒）
words.definition: Natural material such as clay, soil and rock that has no contamination, rubbish or organic waste.

examples.en: Only cleanfill can go to that site; anything contaminated goes to landfill.
examples.zh: 只有清洁土才能拉去那个场地，受污染的要去垃圾填埋场。

words.note: cleanfill 也指专门接收这类土的倾倒场；倒土要付费（tipping fee）。

words.zh: 弃土（挖出来不要的土）
words.definition: Excavated material that is not needed or not suitable, and has to be removed or reused elsewhere.

examples.en: We'll cart the spoil to the cleanfill site.
examples.zh: 我们会把弃土拉到填土场。

words.note: 这里 spoil 是名词“弃土”，不是“宠坏”的意思。

words.zh: 挖出清走（把烂泥或弃土挖走）
words.definition: Informal: to dig out and remove mud, soft material or spoil.

examples.en: Muck out the soft stuff and we'll replace it with hardfill.
examples.zh: 把软泥挖掉，我们换成碎石。

words.note: 现场口语；muck 本身就是“烂泥、弃土”。

words.zh: 外运（用卡车把土运走）
words.definition: To take material off site by truck.

examples.en: We'll need about forty truckloads to cart away the spoil.
examples.zh: 大概需要四十车才能把弃土运走。

words.note: NZ/UK 常用 cart 作动词，cart to waste = 运走丢弃。

words.zh: 外购土石（从场外运进来的填料）
words.definition: Fill or aggregate brought onto site from somewhere else, or the act of bringing it in.

examples.en: If the site is short of fill, we'll have to import from the quarry.
examples.zh: 如果场内土不够，就得从采石场运进来。

words.zh: 堆料（堆放的土或材料）
words.definition: A pile of soil, aggregate or other material stored on site for later use.

examples.en: Cover the topsoil stockpile before the rain comes.
examples.zh: 下雨前把表土堆盖好。

words.zh: 边坡（挖方或填方的斜坡面）
words.definition: The sloping face at the edge of a cut or fill.

examples.en: The batter is designed at one in three.
examples.zh: 边坡设计坡度是1:3。

words.note: NZ/Aus 用 batter 表示边坡；坡度常说 one in two（竖1横2）。

words.zh: 台阶开挖（把坡面挖成台阶）
words.definition: Cutting steps into a slope, either so new fill bonds into it or to make an excavation safer.

examples.en: Bench into the existing slope before you place any fill.
examples.zh: 填土之前先把原坡面挖成台阶。

words.zh: 路堤（填起来的土堤）
words.definition: A raised bank of compacted fill that carries a road or railway above the surrounding ground.

examples.en: The embankment needs time to settle before we can pave it.
examples.zh: 路堤需要时间沉降，之后才能铺路面。

words.zh: 压实（用机械把土压密）
words.definition: Pressing soil or aggregate down with rollers or plates so it becomes dense and strong.

examples.en: Poor compaction is the main reason the trench settled.
examples.zh: 压实不够是沟槽沉降的主要原因。

words.zh: 填筑层（每次铺压的一层）
words.definition: One layer of fill or aggregate placed and compacted before the next goes on top.

examples.en: Place the fill in 200 millimetre lifts.
examples.zh: 填土按每层200毫米铺筑。

words.note: 这里 lift 是“一层”，不是电梯；也说 layer。

words.zh: 压实度检测
words.definition: A test on site that checks whether soil or aggregate has been compacted enough.

examples.en: Hold the next layer until the compaction tests come back.
examples.zh: 等压实检测结果出来再铺下一层。

words.zh: 斯卡拉贯入仪（落锤测土层承载力）
words.definition: A hand-held tool that drops a weight to drive a rod into the ground, measuring how hard the soil is.

examples.en: Run a Scala at each footing location before we pour.
examples.zh: 浇筑前在每个基础位置做一次斯卡拉贯入试验。

words.note: 新西兰常说 a Scala 或 Scala test；它是一种动力触探仪（dynamic cone penetrometer）。

words.zh: 核子密度仪（测压实密度和含水量）
words.definition: A test gauge that uses a small radioactive source to measure the density and moisture of compacted soil or aggregate.

examples.en: The lab will bring the nuclear densometer out for the basecourse tests.
examples.zh: 实验室会带核子密度仪来测基层。

words.note: 常简称 NDM 或 nuke；操作人员需要辐射许可，旁人要保持距离。

words.zh: 克莱格锤（快速测压实硬度的落锤仪）
words.definition: A test tool that drops a weight on the surface and reads how hard the compacted layer is.

examples.en: The Clegg readings on the subgrade were lower than we expected.
examples.zh: 路基的克莱格锤读数比预期低。

words.zh: 承载力（地基能承受的压力）
words.definition: How much load the ground can safely carry without failing or settling too much.

examples.en: The bearing capacity is fine once we get below the soft layer.
examples.zh: 挖过软弱层后承载力就没问题了。

words.zh: 试碾（用重车或压路机碾压找软点）
words.definition: Driving a heavy roller or loaded truck over the subgrade to find soft spots before building on it.

examples.en: The engineer wants to see a proof roll before we put the sub-base down.
examples.zh: 工程师要先看试碾，再铺底基层。

words.zh: 软弱点（压不实、会下陷的区域）
words.definition: A small area of ground that is too soft or wet and moves under load.

examples.en: There's a soft spot near chainage 340; we'll dig it out.
examples.zh: 桩号340附近有一处软点，我们会挖掉。

words.zh: 超挖换填（把软弱土多挖掉再用好料填回）
words.definition: To dig out unsuitable soft ground below the design level and replace it with good fill or aggregate.

examples.en: We had to undercut half a metre under the new road.
examples.zh: 新路下面我们不得不超挖半米换填。

words.note: 现场常说 undercut and replace；这部分通常要另算工程量。

words.zh: 不适用土（太软、太湿或含有机物，不能用作填料）
words.definition: Soil that cannot be used as fill or left in place because it is too wet, soft or organic.

examples.en: Any unsuitable material has to be measured before it goes off site.
examples.zh: 所有不适用土在运走前都要先计量。

words.zh: 含水量
words.definition: How much water is in a soil, which affects how well it can be compacted.

examples.en: The clay is way too wet; the moisture content is over the limit.
examples.zh: 这黏土太湿了，含水量超标。

words.zh: 岩土（岩土工程或岩土工程师的口语简称）
words.definition: Short for geotechnical, or for the geotechnical engineer on a project.

examples.en: Get the geotech out to look at the base of the excavation.
examples.zh: 叫岩土工程师来看一下基坑底部。

words.note: geotech 可以指人（岩土工程师），也可以指报告或专业，如 geotech report。

words.zh: 岩土勘察（钻孔、试坑了解地下土层）
words.definition: Testing the ground with boreholes, test pits and lab tests to understand the soil and rock before design.

examples.en: The geotechnical investigation found peat under the north side of the site.
examples.zh: 岩土勘察发现场地北侧下面有泥炭土。

words.zh: 试坑（用挖机挖坑看土层）
words.definition: A hole dug with an excavator so an engineer can see and sample the soil layers.

examples.en: We dug six test pits along the new road alignment.
examples.zh: 我们沿着新路线挖了六个试坑。

words.zh: 钻孔（勘察用）
words.definition: A narrow hole drilled into the ground to take soil or rock samples or to measure groundwater.

examples.en: The deepest borehole hit rock at twelve metres.
examples.zh: 最深的钻孔在十二米处碰到岩石。

words.zh: 地下水
words.definition: Water held in the soil and rock below the ground surface.

examples.en: We hit groundwater at about two metres, so we'll need to pump.
examples.zh: 大约两米深就碰到地下水，所以得抽水。

words.zh: 降水（施工时抽走地下水）
words.definition: Pumping water out of an excavation or lowering the groundwater so work can be done in the dry.

examples.en: Dewatering for the pump station will run twenty-four hours a day.
examples.zh: 泵站的降水要二十四小时不停。

words.zh: 液化（地震时饱和砂土像液体一样流动）
words.definition: When shaking from an earthquake makes wet, loose sandy soil lose its strength and behave like a liquid.

examples.en: The site is in a liquefaction-prone area, so the pipes need flexible joints.
examples.zh: 这个场地处于易液化区，所以管道需要柔性接头。

words.note: 基督城地震后新西兰非常重视液化问题，设计和报告里经常出现。

words.zh: 塌方/滑坡（新西兰口语）
words.definition: New Zealand word for a landslide, where part of a slope slides down.

examples.en: A slip has closed the road; we're sending a digger to clear it.
examples.zh: 塌方把路堵了，我们派挖机去清理。

words.note: 新西兰常说 slip，不太说 landslide；路下方坡体滑走叫 underslip，路上方塌下来叫 overslip。

words.zh: 水土流失与泥沙控制（简称 ESC）
words.definition: Measures that stop soil washing off a site into streams and stormwater during construction.

examples.en: The council inspector checks our erosion and sediment control after every big rain.
examples.zh: 每次大雨后市政检查员都来查我们的泥沙控制措施。

words.note: 常缩写 ESC；是资源许可里非常重要、经常被检查的部分。

words.zh: 防淤布围栏（拦截泥沙的土工布矮围栏）
words.definition: A low fence of fabric dug into the ground that stops muddy runoff carrying soil off the site.

examples.en: The silt fence along the stream has been knocked over again.
examples.zh: 溪边的防淤围栏又被撞倒了。

words.zh: 沉淀池（让泥水沉淀后再排放）
words.definition: A temporary pond that holds muddy runoff from a site long enough for the soil to settle before the water is discharged.

examples.en: The sediment retention pond has to be built before any bulk earthworks.
examples.zh: 大方量土方开始前必须先建好沉淀池。

words.note: 常缩写 SRP；有时会加絮凝剂（flocculant）帮助泥沙沉淀。

words.zh: 清水导流（把场外清水引开不进施工区）
words.definition: A channel or bund that keeps clean water from outside the site away from bare, disturbed ground.

examples.en: Put a clean water diversion along the top of the cut.
examples.zh: 在挖方坡顶做一道清水导流沟。

words.note: 与 dirty water diversion（把场内泥水引到沉淀池）相对。

words.zh: 泥水导流（把场内泥水引进沉淀池）
words.definition: A channel or bund that directs muddy water from the work area into a sediment pond.

examples.en: The dirty water diversion isn't reaching the pond; it's spilling onto the road.
examples.zh: 泥水导流沟没把水引进沉淀池，都流到马路上了。

words.zh: 稳定化工地出入口（碎石出入口，减少带泥上路）
words.definition: A pad of coarse aggregate at a site exit that knocks mud off truck wheels before they reach the road.

examples.en: Top up the stabilised construction entrance; there's mud all over the road.
examples.zh: 给工地出入口补些碎石，路上全是泥。

words.zh: 抑尘（洒水等方式控制扬尘）
words.definition: Watering or other methods to stop dust blowing off a site.

examples.en: It's windy, so get the water cart going for dust suppression.
examples.zh: 风大，让洒水车开始抑尘。

words.zh: 施工便道（运土车走的临时道路）
words.definition: A temporary road on or near a site that dump trucks and other plant use to move material.

examples.en: Grade the haul road this morning; it's full of ruts.
examples.zh: 今早把施工便道刮平，全是车辙。

words.zh: 喷播植草（把种子和覆盖物混合喷到坡面）
words.definition: Spraying a mix of seed, mulch and fertiliser onto bare ground to grow grass quickly and stop erosion.

examples.en: Once the batters are trimmed, we'll get them hydroseeded.
examples.zh: 边坡修整好后，我们就安排喷播植草。

words.zh: 稳定化处理（掺石灰或水泥加固土）
words.definition: Mixing lime or cement into soil to make it stronger and less affected by water.

examples.en: The design uses lime stabilisation of the subgrade instead of undercutting.
examples.zh: 设计采用石灰稳定路基，而不是超挖换填。

words.note: NZ/英式拼写 stabilisation；美式 stabilization。

words.zh: 修整（把面层修到准确标高）
words.definition: To shape a surface or batter accurately to the final design level.

examples.en: Trim the subgrade to level and call the surveyor to check it.
examples.zh: 把路基修整到标高后叫测量员来检查。

words.zh: 破碎岩石（用破碎锤打石头）
words.definition: Breaking up hard rock with a hydraulic hammer on an excavator.

examples.en: We hit rock in the trench, so we'll need the rock breaker tomorrow.
examples.zh: 沟里碰到岩石了，明天需要破碎锤。

words.zh: 污染土地（土里有有害物质）
words.definition: Ground containing harmful substances, such as fuel, asbestos or heavy metals, from past use.

examples.en: If we find contaminated land, it has to be tested and taken to an approved landfill.
examples.zh: 如果发现污染土，必须检测并运到批准的填埋场。

words.zh: 意外发现程序（挖到文物或遗骸时的处理流程）
words.definition: The steps to follow if digging uncovers possible archaeological items, human remains or taonga: stop work, secure the area and notify the right people.

examples.en: If you find bones or shells, stop and follow the accidental discovery protocol.
examples.zh: 如果挖到骨头或贝壳，要停工并按意外发现程序处理。

words.note: 新西兰土方项目常见要求，常缩写 ADP；通常需要通知考古人员和当地毛利部落（mana whenua）。

words.zh: 沉降（地面或结构慢慢下沉）
words.definition: Slow sinking of ground or a structure as the soil underneath compresses.

examples.en: We'll monitor settlement on the embankment for three months.
examples.zh: 我们会对路堤的沉降监测三个月。

words.note: 工程里 settlement 是“沉降”；日常还有“定居点、和解”等意思。

words.zh: 松散系数（土挖出后体积变大的比例）
words.definition: How much the volume of soil increases once it is dug up and loosened, compared with in the ground.

examples.en: Allow a swell factor when you work out the number of truckloads.
examples.zh: 算车次时要考虑松散系数。

words.note: 原状体积叫 bank volume，挖出松散后叫 loose volume，压实后叫 compacted volume。

words.zh: 路基成形面（路面结构下修整好的土基面）
words.definition: The prepared and shaped ground surface that the road pavement layers are built on.

examples.en: The formation needs to be at the right level and crossfall before we put metal on it.
examples.zh: 铺碎石前，路基面必须做到正确的标高和横坡。

words.note: formation level 常缩写 FL；不是“形成”的一般意思。

words.zh: 基层（路面下压实的碎石层）
words.definition: The layer of crushed, graded aggregate just under the road surface that carries most of the traffic load.

examples.en: The basecourse is 150 mm of AP40, compacted and tested.
examples.zh: 基层是150毫米的AP40碎石，压实并检测。

words.note: 新西兰写成一个词 basecourse；顶上再做 seal 或 asphalt。

words.zh: 底基层（基层下面的碎石层）
words.definition: The layer of aggregate between the subgrade and the basecourse that spreads the load.

examples.en: We've got 250 mm of sub-base to go in before the basecourse.
examples.zh: 铺基层之前还要铺250毫米底基层。

words.zh: AP40 碎石（最大粒径40毫米的级配碎石）
words.definition: A New Zealand name for crushed aggregate where all particles pass a 40 mm sieve, commonly used for basecourse.

examples.en: Order two truck and trailers of AP40 for the car park.
examples.zh: 给停车场订两车带拖斗的AP40。

words.note: AP = all passing（全部通过某尺寸筛孔）；也常见 AP20、AP65 等，数字是最大粒径（毫米）。具体规格以图纸和规范为准。

words.zh: 碎石封层（喷沥青后撒碎石的路面）
words.definition: A road surface made by spraying hot bitumen and then spreading and rolling stone chips into it.

examples.en: Most rural roads in New Zealand are chip seal, not asphalt.
examples.zh: 新西兰大多数乡村道路是碎石封层，不是沥青混凝土。

words.note: 新西兰最常见的路面类型；口语直接说 seal 或 chipseal。

words.zh: 封层（路面表层；也作动词“铺封层”）
words.definition: The thin waterproof surface on a road, usually chip seal; as a verb, to put that surface on.

examples.en: We'll seal the new road once the basecourse passes testing.
examples.zh: 基层检测合格后我们就铺封层。

words.note: sealed road = 有铺装的路；unsealed road = 碎石土路。

words.zh: 重新封层（在旧路面上再铺一层碎石封层）
words.definition: Putting a new layer of chip seal over an old road surface to waterproof it and restore grip.

examples.en: The reseal programme runs from November to March.
examples.zh: 重新封层计划从十一月持续到三月。

words.note: 封层需要温暖干燥的天气，所以新西兰的 sealing season 在夏季。

words.zh: 首层封层（新路基层上的第一次封层）
words.definition: The first chip seal sprayed onto a newly built basecourse.

examples.en: The first coat seal will need a second coat in a year or two.
examples.zh: 首层封层一两年后需要再做第二层。

words.zh: 双层封层（两层沥青碎石，粒径一大一小）
words.definition: A chip seal with two layers of chips, a larger one and then a smaller one, for more strength.

examples.en: Intersections usually get a two-coat seal because of the turning traffic.
examples.zh: 交叉口因为转弯车多，通常做双层封层。

words.zh: 松散碎石（新封层表面未粘牢的石子）
words.definition: Stone chips that have not stuck to a new seal and can fly up and crack windscreens.

examples.en: Put out the loose chips signs and get the sweeper through tomorrow.
examples.zh: 放好“碎石松散”标志，明天让清扫车扫一遍。

words.note: 新封层后常设 Loose Chips 标志和限速，防止石子打坏车辆。

words.zh: 碎石土路（没有沥青封层的路）
words.definition: A road with a gravel surface and no bitumen seal.

examples.en: The unsealed road needs grading after every heavy rain.
examples.zh: 这条碎石路每次大雨后都要刮平。

words.note: 新西兰也叫 gravel road 或 metal road。

words.zh: 碎石料（新西兰口语，路用碎石）
words.definition: New Zealand word for crushed rock or gravel used on roads.

examples.en: Chuck some metal on that driveway; it's all mud.
examples.zh: 在那条车道上撒点碎石，全是泥。

words.note: 新西兰特有用法：road metal = 路用碎石，metal road = 碎石路，与“金属”无关。

words.zh: 沥青混凝土（沥青拌碎石的路面）
words.definition: A road surface made of stones mixed with bitumen, laid hot and rolled smooth.

examples.en: The roundabout will be surfaced with asphalt, not chip seal.
examples.zh: 环岛会铺沥青混凝土，而不是碎石封层。

words.note: 新西兰常把沥青混凝土叫 asphalt、hotmix 或 AC；美国口语叫 blacktop。注意 bitumen 是胶结料本身。

words.zh: 热拌沥青（现场对沥青混凝土的叫法）
words.definition: Informal word for asphalt that is mixed and laid hot.

examples.en: The hotmix truck is booked for six tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 热拌料车订在明早六点。

words.zh: 沥青混凝土（asphaltic concrete 缩写）
words.definition: Short for asphaltic concrete, a dense asphalt mix used for road surfaces.

examples.en: The spec calls for 40 mm of AC on the bus lanes.
examples.zh: 规范要求公交车道铺40毫米AC。

words.note: AC 后面的数字通常表示最大粒径，如 AC10、AC14。

words.zh: 开级配透水沥青（排水降噪沥青路面）
words.definition: Open graded porous asphalt: a surface with gaps that let water drain through and reduce tyre noise.

examples.en: The motorway gets OGPA to cut down noise and spray.
examples.zh: 高速公路铺OGPA以减少噪音和溅水。

words.note: 读作字母 O-G-P-A；常用于新西兰高速路。

words.zh: 粘层油（铺沥青前喷的一层薄沥青乳液）
words.definition: A thin spray of bitumen emulsion on an existing surface to help a new asphalt layer stick to it.

examples.en: Don't drive on the tack coat; it sticks to everything.
examples.zh: 别在粘层油上开车，它什么都粘。

words.zh: 铣刨（把旧沥青表面刨掉）
words.definition: Grinding off the top layer of an old asphalt road with a milling machine before resurfacing.

examples.en: Milling starts at 8 pm and the new asphalt goes down straight after.
examples.zh: 晚上八点开始铣刨，随后马上铺新沥青。

words.zh: 坑洞（路面上的坑）
words.definition: A hole in a road surface caused by water and traffic breaking up the pavement.

examples.en: We've had twenty pothole callouts since the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨以后我们接了二十个修坑洞的报修。

words.zh: 路缘石和边沟（路边混凝土路缘加排水沟）
words.definition: The concrete edge along a road (kerb) joined to a shallow gutter (channel) that carries stormwater.

examples.en: The kerb and channel crew is slip-forming the east side today.
examples.zh: 路缘边沟班组今天在东侧滑模施工。

words.note: 新西兰拼写 kerb（美国拼 curb）；常缩写 K&C。

words.zh: 路缘石（马路边的凸起边沿）
words.definition: The raised edge between the road and the footpath.

examples.en: Mind the new kerb; the concrete's still green.
examples.zh: 小心新路缘石，混凝土还没硬透。

words.note: NZ/英式拼写 kerb，美式 curb，读音相同。

words.zh: 碟形边沟（浅弧形混凝土排水沟）
words.definition: A shallow, saucer-shaped concrete channel that carries water across or along a road.

examples.en: Put a dish channel across the entrance so the water doesn't pond.
examples.zh: 在入口处做一道碟形边沟，免得积水。

words.zh: 人行道
words.definition: A paved path beside a road for people walking.

examples.en: The footpath will be closed, so we need a safe route for pedestrians.
examples.zh: 人行道会封闭，所以需要给行人安排安全通道。

words.note: 新西兰说 footpath；美国 sidewalk；英国 pavement。

words.zh: 路边草地（人行道与马路或地界之间的草带）
words.definition: New Zealand word for the grass strip between the road and the property boundary or footpath.

examples.en: Keep the plant off the berm; the residents hate tyre marks on their grass.
examples.zh: 机械别开上路边草地，居民最讨厌草上有车辙。

words.note: 新西兰特有用法；在其他英语地区 berm 多指土堤或平台。

words.zh: 车辆出入口（人行道上进出住宅的车道段）
words.definition: The section of driveway that crosses the footpath and berm from the road to a property.

examples.en: Each lot gets a concrete vehicle crossing built to council standard.
examples.zh: 每个地块都按市政标准做一个混凝土车道出入口。

words.note: 新西兰正式说法；口语有时也叫 driveway crossing。

words.zh: 自行车道
words.definition: A path or lane built for people on bikes.

examples.en: The new cycleway is separated from traffic by a concrete kerb.
examples.zh: 新自行车道用混凝土路缘与车辆隔开。

words.zh: 共享步道（行人和自行车共用）
words.definition: A path used by both people walking and people cycling.

examples.en: The shared path is three metres wide along the river.
examples.zh: 沿河的共享步道宽三米。

words.zh: 道路标线
words.definition: Painted lines, arrows and symbols on a road surface.

examples.en: Road marking can't happen until the new seal has cured.
examples.zh: 新封层养护好之前不能画标线。

words.zh: 反光路钮（俗称猫眼）
words.definition: Raised reflective pavement marker: a small reflector stuck to the road that shines in headlights.

examples.en: Replace the RRPMs that came off during the reseal.
examples.zh: 把重新封层时掉落的反光路钮补上。

words.note: 口语叫 cat's eyes；RRPM 是图纸和合同用语。

words.zh: 减速带（路面上的凸起）
words.definition: A raised bump across a road that makes drivers slow down.

examples.en: Residents asked for speed humps outside the school.
examples.zh: 居民要求在学校门前设减速带。

words.note: NZ/UK 多说 speed hump，美国多说 speed bump。

words.zh: 减速平台（平顶的长减速带，常兼作人行横道）
words.definition: A long, flat-topped hump that slows traffic, often used as a pedestrian crossing.

examples.en: The raised speed table doubles as a crossing point.
examples.zh: 这个抬高的减速平台同时是过街点。

words.zh: 环岛（环形交叉口）
words.definition: A circular intersection where traffic goes around a central island.

examples.en: The new roundabout replaces the old T-intersection.
examples.zh: 新环岛取代了原来的丁字路口。

words.zh: 交叉口（路口）
words.definition: A place where two or more roads meet or cross.

examples.en: The intersection will be done in stages to keep traffic moving.
examples.zh: 交叉口会分阶段施工，以保持交通通行。

words.zh: 车行道（供车辆通行的路面部分）
words.definition: The part of a road used by vehicles, not including the shoulders and footpaths.

examples.en: We'll work on the northbound carriageway first.
examples.zh: 我们先做北向车行道。

words.note: dual carriageway = 双向分隔的道路。

words.zh: 车道
words.definition: One strip of a carriageway wide enough for a single line of vehicles.

examples.en: The new design narrows each traffic lane to slow cars down.
examples.zh: 新设计把每条车道变窄以降低车速。

words.zh: 路肩（车道外侧的边缘部分）
words.definition: The strip beside the traffic lanes, used for stopping, cyclists or as a safety margin.

examples.en: Widen the shoulder by a metre on both sides.
examples.zh: 两侧路肩各加宽一米。

words.zh: 横坡（路面横向的排水坡度）
words.definition: The sideways slope across a road surface that lets water run off to the edge.

examples.en: The design crossfall is three percent to the kerb.
examples.zh: 设计横坡是向路缘3%。

words.note: 与 camber 相关：camber 指中间高两边低的路拱形状。

words.zh: 路拱（路面中间高两侧低）
words.definition: The shape of a road that is higher in the middle and slopes down to both sides to shed water.

examples.en: The old road has almost no camber, so water sits on it.
examples.zh: 旧路几乎没有路拱，所以积水。

words.zh: 超高（弯道外侧加高的横坡）
words.definition: Tilting a road across a curve, with the outside edge higher, so vehicles can corner safely.

examples.en: Check the superelevation through the bend before we pave.
examples.zh: 铺路面前检查弯道的超高。

words.zh: 交通岛（路中凸起的分隔或安全岛）
words.definition: A raised area in the road that separates traffic or gives pedestrians a safe place to wait.

examples.en: The traffic island needs a cut-down for prams and wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 交通岛需要做一个缓坡方便婴儿车和轮椅。

words.zh: 中央分隔带
words.definition: The strip in the middle of a road that separates traffic going in opposite directions.

examples.en: A wire rope barrier will go down the median.
examples.zh: 中央分隔带会安装钢丝绳护栏。

words.zh: 钢丝绳护栏
words.definition: A roadside or median safety barrier made of steel cables on posts that catches vehicles leaving the lane.

examples.en: We have to repair the wire rope barrier after every crash.
examples.zh: 每次撞车后我们都要修钢丝绳护栏。

words.note: 新西兰公路上很常见，国外也叫 cable barrier。

words.zh: 波形护栏（钢板护栏）
words.definition: A steel safety barrier along the edge of a road or bridge approach.

examples.en: Extend the guardrail past the end of the culvert headwall.
examples.zh: 把护栏延长到涵洞端墙之外。

words.zh: 人行横道
words.definition: A marked place where people can cross the road, such as a zebra crossing.

examples.en: The new pedestrian crossing has a raised table and better lighting.
examples.zh: 新的人行横道有抬高平台和更好的照明。

words.zh: 路边破损（路面边缘碎裂）
words.definition: Damage where the edge of a sealed road crumbles away.

examples.en: Edge break is bad on the narrow rural roads where trucks run off the seal.
examples.zh: 在窄的乡村道路上卡车会压出路面边缘，边缘破损很严重。

words.zh: 车辙（路面被车轮压出的凹槽）
words.definition: Grooves pressed into a road surface along the wheel paths by heavy traffic.

examples.en: The rutting at the bus stop is about 30 mm deep.
examples.zh: 公交站的车辙大约30毫米深。

words.zh: 泛油（沥青冒到碎石表面，路面发亮发滑）
words.definition: When bitumen rises above the chips on a chip seal, making the surface shiny and slippery.

examples.en: Flushing gets worse on hot days, and the road gets slippery when wet.
examples.zh: 天热时泛油加重，下雨时路面变滑。

words.note: 也叫 bleeding；在日常英语里 flushing 是“冲水、脸红”。

words.zh: 抗滑性能
words.definition: How much grip a road surface gives tyres, especially when wet.

examples.en: The skid resistance survey flagged this corner for a reseal.
examples.zh: 抗滑检测把这个弯道标为需要重新封层。

words.zh: 灌缝（用沥青填补裂缝）
words.definition: Filling cracks in a road surface with bitumen to stop water getting in.

examples.en: Crack sealing before winter will save us a lot of potholes.
examples.zh: 冬天前做灌缝可以减少很多坑洞。

words.zh: 路灯
words.definition: A light on a pole that lights a road or footpath.

examples.en: The street light poles go in after the footpath is poured.
examples.zh: 人行道浇筑后再立路灯杆。

words.zh: 视距（驾驶员能看清前方的距离）
words.definition: How far ahead a driver can see, which decides whether an intersection or access is safe.

examples.en: The hedge cuts the sight distance at the corner, so it has to go.
examples.zh: 那排树篱挡住了路口视距，必须移除。

words.zh: 污水管（口语，也指整个污水系统）
words.definition: A pipe that carries wastewater from homes and businesses to a treatment plant.

examples.en: The sewer is deeper than the stormwater, so lay it first.
examples.zh: 污水管比雨水管深，所以先铺污水管。

words.note: sewer 是管道，sewage 是里面的污水，sewerage 是整个系统。

words.zh: 供水主管
words.definition: A large underground pipe that carries drinking water along a street.

examples.en: A burst water main has flooded the intersection.
examples.zh: 供水主管爆裂淹了路口。

words.zh: 支线供水管（沿街给住户接水的小管）
words.definition: A smaller water pipe running along a street, fed from the main, that individual properties connect to.

examples.en: The houses connect to the rider main, not straight to the trunk main.
examples.zh: 住户接到支线供水管，而不是直接接到干管。

words.zh: 输水干管（大口径主干管）
words.definition: A large pipe that carries water or wastewater in bulk between major parts of a network.

examples.en: The trunk main shutdown has to be done in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 干管停水必须在半夜进行。

words.zh: 压力管（泵站出来往高处送的压力污水管）
words.definition: A pressure pipe that carries wastewater pumped from a pump station uphill to a higher point.

examples.en: The rising main from the pump station runs two kilometres up the hill.
examples.zh: 泵站出来的压力管沿山坡往上铺两公里。

words.note: 与 gravity main（重力管，靠坡度自流）相对。

words.zh: 重力管（靠坡度自流的管道）
words.definition: A pipe laid at a steady slope so that water or wastewater flows downhill without pumping.

examples.en: The gravity main needs a minimum fall of one in two hundred.
examples.zh: 重力管至少需要1:200的坡度。

words.zh: 检查井（人孔）
words.definition: An underground chamber with a lid at street level that gives access to pipes for inspection and cleaning.

examples.en: The new manhole is at the low corner of the site.
examples.zh: 新检查井在场地最低的角落。

words.note: 常缩写 MH，图纸上有编号，如 MH 12。

words.zh: 雨水口（路边收集雨水的格栅井）
words.definition: A pit with a grate at the edge of a road that collects stormwater and sends it into the pipes.

examples.en: The sump outside number 14 is blocked with leaves.
examples.zh: 14号门口的雨水口被树叶堵了。

words.note: 新西兰不同地区叫法不同：sump、catchpit、cesspit 都指路边雨水口。

words.zh: 雨水收集井（雨水口的另一种叫法）
words.definition: Another word for a roadside stormwater pit with a grate, used in parts of New Zealand.

examples.en: Clean out the catchpits before we hand the road over.
examples.zh: 道路移交前把雨水口清理干净。

words.zh: 涵洞（路下穿过的过水管或箱涵）
words.definition: A pipe or box that carries a stream or stormwater under a road, railway or driveway.

examples.en: The culvert was too small and the water went over the road.
examples.zh: 涵洞太小，水漫过了路面。

words.zh: 端墙（涵洞或管道出口的挡墙）
words.definition: A concrete or rock wall at the end of a pipe or culvert that holds the bank and protects the outlet.

examples.en: Pour the headwall once the culvert is in and backfilled.
examples.zh: 涵洞安装并回填后浇筑端墙。

words.note: 两侧斜伸的墙叫 wingwall（翼墙）。

words.zh: 排放口（管道末端排到河流或海里的出口）
words.definition: The point where a stormwater or wastewater pipe discharges into a river, stream or the sea.

examples.en: Put rock protection at the outfall so the stream bank doesn't scour.
examples.zh: 在排放口放护石，免得冲刷河岸。

words.zh: 渗水井（让雨水渗入地下的井）
words.definition: A pit filled with gravel or a perforated chamber that lets stormwater soak into the ground.

examples.en: In this area, every house has a soakhole instead of a stormwater connection.
examples.zh: 这个区每户都用渗水井，而不是接雨水管。

words.note: 新西兰常用词（尤其火山土地区），也叫 soak pit。

words.zh: 植草沟（浅而宽的绿化排水沟）
words.definition: A shallow, grassed channel that carries and filters stormwater.

examples.en: The swale along the road treats the runoff before it reaches the stream.
examples.zh: 路边的植草沟在径流进入溪流前做了处理。

words.zh: 雨水花园（种植池收集过滤雨水）
words.definition: A planted garden in a low area designed to collect, filter and soak away stormwater.

examples.en: The rain gardens need planting before the council will accept the road.
examples.zh: 雨水花园要种好植物，市政才会接收这条路。

words.zh: 雨水调蓄池（暂存雨水、削峰并沉淀）
words.definition: A pond that holds stormwater after heavy rain and releases it slowly, also letting sediment settle.

examples.en: The stormwater pond doubles as a park feature.
examples.zh: 雨水调蓄池同时是公园的景观。

words.note: 也叫 detention pond；建成的湿地式的叫 stormwater wetland。

words.zh: 人工湿地（雨水处理用）
words.definition: A planted, shallow water area that slows and cleans stormwater naturally.

examples.en: The wetland planting is done by a specialist landscaping crew.
examples.zh: 湿地种植由专业的绿化班组完成。

words.zh: 管底标高（管道内底的高程）
words.definition: The height of the inside bottom of a pipe or channel, used to set its depth and fall.

examples.en: Check the invert level at both manholes before you lay the pipe.
examples.zh: 铺管前先检查两个检查井的管底标高。

words.note: 常缩写 IL；图纸上每个井都标 IL in / IL out。

words.zh: 管沟（铺管挖的长沟）
words.definition: A long, narrow excavation dug to lay pipes or cables.

examples.en: The trench is over 1.5 metres deep, so it needs a trench shield.
examples.zh: 管沟超过1.5米深，所以要用沟槽支护箱。

words.zh: 管道垫层（管下铺的砂或细碎石）
words.definition: Fine aggregate placed under and around a pipe to support it evenly and protect it.

examples.en: Use the bedding the spec calls for, not whatever's in the yard.
examples.zh: 用规范要求的垫层料，别随便用堆场里的。

words.zh: 管腋填料（管道两侧下半部的填料）
words.definition: The bedding material packed in around the lower sides of a pipe to support it.

examples.en: Hand-compact the haunching so there are no voids under the pipe.
examples.zh: 管腋要人工压实，确保管下没有空隙。

words.zh: 回填（把管沟或基坑填回去）
words.definition: Material put back into a trench or excavation after the pipe or structure is in; also the act of filling it.

examples.en: Backfill in layers and compact each one properly.
examples.zh: 回填要分层，每层都要压实。

words.zh: 非开挖（不挖明沟就能铺管或修管）
words.definition: Methods that install or repair pipes underground without digging an open trench along the whole length.

examples.en: Under the state highway, we'll go trenchless rather than dig up the road.
examples.zh: 穿过国道这段我们用非开挖，而不是挖开路面。

words.zh: 定向钻（非开挖钻孔铺管）
words.definition: A trenchless method that steers a drill underground along a planned path and pulls a pipe back through.

examples.en: Directional drilling under the river saves us a coffer dam.
examples.zh: 用定向钻穿河省掉了围堰。

words.note: 常缩写 HDD（horizontal directional drilling）。

words.zh: 胀管法（在旧管内破碎旧管并拉入新管）
words.definition: A trenchless method that breaks an old pipe from inside while pulling a new pipe in behind.

examples.en: Pipe bursting means only two pits instead of digging up the whole street.
examples.zh: 胀管法只需挖两个坑，而不是挖开整条街。

words.zh: 内衬修复（在旧管道内加一层新衬管）
words.definition: Repairing an old pipe by putting a new lining inside it, without digging it up.

examples.en: The CCTV shows cracks, so the pipe is going on the relining list.
examples.zh: 管道检测录像显示有裂缝，所以列入内衬修复清单。

words.zh: 管道闭路电视检测（用摄像头检查管道内部）
words.definition: Sending a camera through a pipe to record its condition and find cracks, roots or blockages.

examples.en: We need a CCTV inspection of the new sewer before the council will accept it.
examples.zh: 新污水管要做CCTV检测，市政才会接收。

words.note: 这里 CCTV 指管道内窥摄像，不是监控摄像头。

words.zh: 支管（从主管接到每户的分支管）
words.definition: The branch pipe that connects a property to the public main.

examples.en: Each lot has its own wastewater lateral and stormwater lateral.
examples.zh: 每个地块都有自己的污水支管和雨水支管。

words.zh: 接驳（新管接入现有管网）
words.definition: The point where a new pipe joins an existing pipe or a property joins the public network.

examples.en: The connection to the live main is booked for Tuesday night.
examples.zh: 接入在用主管的作业定在周二晚上。

words.zh: 在用管道（正在通水的管道）
words.definition: An existing pipe that is in service and full of water or wastewater.

examples.en: Check who is approved to work on the live main before we cut in.
examples.zh: 切管前先确认谁有资格在在用主管上作业。

words.zh: 停水（为施工临时关断供水）
words.definition: Turning off the water supply to part of the network so work can be done, usually with notice to residents.

examples.en: Make sure the residents get notice before the planned shutdown.
examples.zh: 计划停水前要确保通知到居民。

words.note: water shutdown；临时供水叫 temporary supply / bypass。

words.zh: 阀门
words.definition: A device in a pipe that can be opened or closed to control or stop the flow.

examples.en: Close the valves at both ends before we cut the pipe.
examples.zh: 切管前把两端的阀门关好。

words.zh: 闸阀（供水管上的阀门）
words.definition: A gate valve on a water main that can be closed to isolate a section of pipe.

examples.en: The sluice valve cover was sealed over during the reseal.
examples.zh: 重新封层时把闸阀盖封住了。

words.note: NZ/英国常说 sluice valve，等同于 gate valve。

words.zh: 消防栓
words.definition: A connection point on a water main that firefighters use to get water.

examples.en: Put a blue marker on the road next to the new hydrant.
examples.zh: 在新消防栓旁边的路面上装一个蓝色标记。

words.note: 新西兰的消防栓多数在地下井盖里，路面用蓝色反光钉或黄色标记标示位置。

words.zh: 防回流装置（防止污水倒流入供水管）
words.definition: A device that stops water flowing backwards from a property into the public water supply.

examples.en: This commercial site needs a testable backflow preventer at the boundary.
examples.zh: 这个商业场地需要在地界处装可检测的防回流装置。

words.zh: 水表
words.definition: A device that measures how much water a property uses.

examples.en: The water meter box sits just inside the boundary.
examples.zh: 水表箱就在地界内侧。

words.zh: 入户总阀（地界处的供水开关，新西兰口语）
words.definition: New Zealand word for the small valve box near the property boundary used to turn a house's water on and off.

examples.en: Turn the water off at the toby before you touch the pipes.
examples.zh: 动水管前先在入户总阀把水关掉。

words.note: 新西兰特有口语，正式叫 boundary valve / service valve。

words.zh: 排水存水井（房屋污水排水口的带水封小井）
words.definition: A small trap outside a house where wastewater pipes discharge, with a water seal to stop smells.

examples.en: The gully trap has to sit above ground level so stormwater can't get in.
examples.zh: 存水井口必须高于地面，以防雨水进入。

words.note: 新西兰/澳大利亚房屋排水常见设施；由持证 drainlayer 安装。

words.zh: 泵站
words.definition: A facility with pumps that lifts wastewater or water to a higher level so it can keep flowing.

examples.en: The pump station has an alarm that goes to the on-call operator.
examples.zh: 泵站有报警，会发送给值班人员。

words.zh: 溢流（污水从井或泵站溢出）
words.definition: When wastewater spills out of a manhole, pump station or pipe because the network is overloaded or blocked.

examples.en: Heavy rain caused a wastewater overflow into the stream.
examples.zh: 大雨导致污水溢流进溪流。

words.zh: 入流和渗入（雨水和地下水进入污水管）
words.definition: Stormwater and groundwater getting into wastewater pipes through cracks, joints and wrong connections.

examples.en: Inflow and infiltration triples the flow at the treatment plant in a storm.
examples.zh: 暴雨时入流和渗入让污水厂的流量增加两倍。

words.note: 常缩写 I&I，是新西兰市政污水管网的大问题。

words.zh: 盲沟（土里的穿孔排水管）
words.definition: A perforated pipe wrapped in gravel or fabric, laid under ground to collect and drain away groundwater.

examples.en: Put a subsoil drain behind the retaining wall.
examples.zh: 在挡土墙后面铺一条盲沟。

words.note: 现场常简称 subsoil drain 或 subsoil；也叫 field drain。

words.zh: 压力试验（检查管道是否漏水）
words.definition: Filling a new pipe and holding it at pressure to check it doesn't leak.

examples.en: The new water main failed its pressure test, so we're looking for the leak.
examples.zh: 新的供水主管压力试验没通过，我们正在找漏点。

words.zh: 消毒（新供水管投入使用前用氯消毒）
words.definition: Cleaning a new water main with chlorine and flushing it before it is connected to the drinking water supply.

examples.en: The main can't be connected until disinfection and the water samples pass.
examples.zh: 消毒和水样检测合格前，主管不能接通。

words.zh: 止推墩（管道弯头处的混凝土墩）
words.definition: A block of concrete poured behind a bend or fitting in a pressure pipe to stop it moving.

examples.en: Pour thrust blocks at every bend before the pressure test.
examples.zh: 压力试验前每个弯头都要浇筑止推墩。

words.zh: 示踪线（随非金属管一起埋的金属线）
words.definition: A wire laid with plastic pipe so the pipe can be found later with a detector.

examples.en: Don't forget the tracer wire on the PE line.
examples.zh: 别忘了在PE管上放示踪线。

words.zh: 警示带（埋在管线上方的彩色胶带）
words.definition: Coloured plastic tape buried above a pipe or cable to warn anyone digging later.

examples.en: Lay the warning tape about 300 mm above the pipe.
examples.zh: 在管道上方约300毫米处铺警示带。

words.zh: 电熔焊接（PE管用电熔管件连接）
words.definition: Joining plastic PE pipes using fittings with built-in wires that heat and melt the joint.

examples.en: All electrofusion joints need a log printout.
examples.zh: 所有电熔接头都要有记录打印件。

words.note: 另一种 PE 管连接方式是 butt welding（对焊）。

words.zh: 管件（弯头、三通等）
words.definition: A part such as a bend, tee or coupling that joins or changes direction of a pipe.

examples.en: We're short of 45-degree bends, so check the fittings before we start.
examples.zh: 我们缺45度弯头，开工前检查一下管件。

words.zh: 排水（排水系统）
words.definition: The pipes, channels and other systems that take water away.

examples.en: Poor drainage is behind most of the road failures on this route.
examples.zh: 这条线路的大多数路面损坏都是因为排水不好。

words.zh: 临时导流抽水（绕过施工段抽送污水）
words.definition: Pumping wastewater around a section of pipe that is being worked on, so the service keeps running.

examples.en: We'll need overpumping while the old sewer is replaced.
examples.zh: 更换旧污水管期间需要临时导流抽水。

words.note: 也叫 bypass pumping。

words.zh: 混凝土
words.definition: A building material made from cement, water, sand and aggregate that sets hard like stone.

examples.en: The concrete is booked for seven, so the boxing has to be signed off tonight.
examples.zh: 混凝土约了七点到，所以模板今晚必须验收。

words.note: concrete 是混凝土；cement 只是里面的胶凝材料，日常口语常混用，但工程上要分清。

words.zh: 水泥（混凝土里的胶结粉料）
words.definition: The grey powder that reacts with water and binds sand and stones together to make concrete.

examples.en: Cement is only one ingredient; don't call the slab a cement slab in front of the engineer.
examples.zh: 水泥只是一种原料，别在工程师面前把混凝土板叫成水泥板。

words.zh: 商品混凝土（搅拌站拌好用罐车运来）
words.definition: Concrete mixed at a plant and delivered to site in a mixer truck.

examples.en: Ring the ready-mix plant and push the pour back an hour.
examples.zh: 打电话给搅拌站，把浇筑推迟一小时。

words.zh: 浇筑（倒混凝土；也指一次浇筑）
words.definition: To place fresh concrete into formwork; as a noun, one session of placing concrete.

examples.en: We've got a 40-cube pour on Thursday.
examples.zh: 周四有一次40立方的浇筑。

words.note: 现场常说 cube（立方米），如 a 40-cube pour。

words.zh: 模板（浇筑混凝土用的临时模具）
words.definition: Temporary moulds, usually timber, plywood or steel, that hold wet concrete in shape until it hardens.

examples.en: The formwork for the headwall is up; we just need the steel inspected.
examples.zh: 端墙的模板已经立好，只等钢筋验收。

words.zh: 模板（新西兰口语，指木模板）
words.definition: New Zealand and Australian word for the timber formwork around a slab, footing or path.

examples.en: Strip the boxing on the footpath tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 明早把人行道的模板拆掉。

words.note: 新西兰/澳洲口语；这里不是“拳击”。

words.zh: 拆模（拆除模板）
words.definition: To remove formwork after the concrete has hardened enough.

examples.en: Don't strip the wall forms until the engineer says so.
examples.zh: 工程师同意之前不要拆墙模。

words.note: strip 也用于 strip topsoil（剥表土），看上下文。

words.zh: 钢筋（螺纹钢）
words.definition: Steel bars placed in concrete to make it strong in tension.

examples.en: The rebar needs to be tied and chaired before the inspection.
examples.zh: 验收前钢筋要绑好并垫好垫块。

words.zh: 配筋（混凝土中的钢筋，统称）
words.definition: All the steel bars and mesh placed inside concrete.

examples.en: The reinforcing inspection is a hold point; we can't pour without it.
examples.zh: 钢筋验收是停止点，没有验收不能浇筑。

words.note: 现场常简称 steel 或 reo，例如 the reo is in（钢筋已经放好）。

words.zh: 钢筋网（焊接钢丝网片）
words.definition: Sheets of steel wire or bars welded into a grid, used to reinforce slabs and paths.

examples.en: Lay the mesh on chairs so it sits in the middle of the slab.
examples.zh: 把钢筋网放在垫块上，使它位于板的中间。

words.zh: 钢筋马凳/垫块（撑起钢筋保证保护层）
words.definition: A small plastic or wire stand that holds reinforcing at the right height inside the formwork.

examples.en: Half the mesh is on the ground; we need more bar chairs.
examples.zh: 一半的钢筋网贴在地上，需要更多垫块。

words.zh: 保护层（钢筋外侧混凝土的厚度）
words.definition: The thickness of concrete between the reinforcing steel and the outside surface, which protects the steel from rust.

examples.en: The engineer measured only 30 mm cover on the edge bars.
examples.zh: 工程师量到边上的钢筋保护层只有30毫米。

words.note: 这里 cover 是专业名词“保护层”，不是“盖子”。

words.zh: 预留钢筋（插筋，从已浇部分伸出来接下一段）
words.definition: Bars left sticking out of one pour so the next pour can be tied to them.

examples.en: Bend the starter bars back up; the digger knocked them over.
examples.zh: 把插筋重新弯直，挖机把它们撞歪了。

words.zh: 搭接（钢筋重叠一段长度绑在一起）
words.definition: The length by which two reinforcing bars overlap so they act as one.

examples.en: Check the laps are the length shown on the drawing.
examples.zh: 检查搭接长度是否和图纸一致。

words.zh: 扎丝（绑钢筋用的细铁丝）
words.definition: Soft steel wire used to tie reinforcing bars together.

examples.en: Bend the tie wire ends in so they don't stick out of the concrete.
examples.zh: 把扎丝头往里弯，免得露出混凝土。

words.zh: 兆帕（混凝土强度单位）
words.definition: Megapascals: the unit used for concrete strength, as in 30 MPa concrete.

examples.en: The bridge deck is 50 MPa; the footpath is only 20.
examples.zh: 桥面是50兆帕的，人行道只有20。

words.note: 读作字母 M-P-A；数字越大强度越高。

words.zh: 坍落度（新拌混凝土的稀稠程度）
words.definition: How much fresh concrete sinks when a cone mould is lifted off, showing how wet and workable it is.

examples.en: Don't add water on site; the slump is already right.
examples.zh: 现场别加水，坍落度已经合适了。

words.zh: 坍落度试验
words.definition: A quick site test where fresh concrete is packed into a cone, the cone is lifted and the drop is measured.

examples.en: Do a slump test on the first truck.
examples.zh: 第一车做一次坍落度试验。

words.zh: 试块抗压试验（圆柱试件）
words.definition: Testing small concrete cylinders, taken during a pour, in a lab to check the strength after 7 or 28 days.

examples.en: The 28-day cylinder results are in, and they're all above 30 MPa.
examples.zh: 28天试块结果出来了，都超过30兆帕。

words.note: 现场说 take cylinders（取试块）；7天、28天强度是常见检测节点。

words.zh: 养护（让混凝土保湿慢慢硬化）
words.definition: To keep new concrete damp and protected so it gains strength properly.

examples.en: Keep the slab wet and let it cure for a week.
examples.zh: 让楼板保持湿润，养护一周。

words.note: 名词 curing；curing compound 是喷在表面的养护剂。

words.zh: 振捣（用振动棒排出混凝土气泡）
words.definition: To shake fresh concrete with a vibrating rod so it fills the formwork with no air pockets.

examples.en: Vibrate it properly around the bars or you'll get honeycombing.
examples.zh: 钢筋周围要振捣到位，否则会出现蜂窝。

words.note: 振动棒现场叫 poker 或 vibrator。

words.zh: 蜂窝（混凝土表面的空洞缺陷）
words.definition: Holes and gaps on a concrete surface where the mix did not fill the formwork properly.

examples.en: There's honeycombing at the bottom of the wall; it'll need patching.
examples.zh: 墙底有蜂窝，需要修补。

words.zh: 刮平（把混凝土表面刮到标高）
words.definition: To level fresh concrete by dragging a straight edge across it; also a thin levelling layer.

examples.en: Two guys screed while one runs the poker.
examples.zh: 两个人刮平，一个人振捣。

words.zh: 抹面（用抹子压平混凝土表面）
words.definition: To smooth the surface of fresh concrete with a flat tool after screeding.

examples.en: Float it off and put a broom finish on the footpath.
examples.zh: 抹平后给人行道做拉毛面。

words.zh: 拉毛面（扫帚扫出防滑纹）
words.definition: A rough, non-slip texture made by dragging a broom across fresh concrete.

examples.en: All the footpaths and crossings get a broom finish.
examples.zh: 所有人行道和出入口都做拉毛面。

words.zh: 切缝（用切割机在混凝土上切控制缝）
words.definition: A cut made in concrete with a saw, either to control cracking or to cut out a section.

examples.en: Saw cut the joints within a day of the pour.
examples.zh: 浇筑后一天内切缝。

words.zh: 施工缝
words.definition: A joint where one concrete pour finishes and the next one starts.

examples.en: Put a construction joint at the end of each bay.
examples.zh: 在每个区段末端设施工缝。

words.zh: 垫层混凝土（基坑底的薄层素混凝土）
words.definition: A thin layer of weak concrete poured at the bottom of an excavation to give a clean, level working surface.

examples.en: Pour 50 mm of blinding before the steel fixers start.
examples.zh: 钢筋工开工前先浇50毫米垫层。

words.zh: 混凝土板（楼板或地坪）
words.definition: A flat, horizontal concrete element such as a floor, deck or pad.

examples.en: The pump station slab is poured; the walls go up next week.
examples.zh: 泵站底板已浇筑，下周起墙。

words.zh: 基础（墙或柱下的扩展基础）
words.definition: The widened concrete base under a wall or column that spreads its load into the ground.

examples.en: The footings have to be dug into the firm clay.
examples.zh: 基础必须挖到坚硬的黏土层。

words.zh: 地基基础（结构下面支撑的部分）
words.definition: The part of a structure, below ground, that carries its weight into the soil or rock.

examples.en: The foundation design depends on the geotech report.
examples.zh: 基础设计取决于岩土报告。

words.zh: 桩
words.definition: A long column of concrete, steel or timber driven or drilled deep into the ground to support a structure.

examples.en: The bridge sits on twelve steel piles.
examples.zh: 这座桥坐落在十二根钢桩上。

words.zh: 打桩（把桩锤入地下）
words.definition: Hammering piles into the ground with a pile-driving rig.

examples.en: Pile driving is noisy, so the consent only lets us do it during the day.
examples.zh: 打桩很吵，所以许可只允许白天进行。

words.zh: 钻孔灌注桩
words.definition: A pile made by drilling a hole, placing a reinforcing cage and filling it with concrete.

examples.en: Bored piles are quieter than driven piles near houses.
examples.zh: 在住宅附近，钻孔桩比打入桩安静。

words.zh: 桩帽（桩顶的混凝土承台）
words.definition: A thick concrete block on top of a group of piles that spreads the load from the structure above.

examples.en: Cut the piles to level before you box the pile cap.
examples.zh: 立承台模板前先把桩切到标高。

words.zh: 挡土墙
words.definition: A wall that holds back soil where the ground level changes.

examples.en: The retaining wall along the boundary is over two metres high.
examples.zh: 沿地界的挡土墙超过两米高。

words.zh: 木桩挡土墙（埋入木柱加木板）
words.definition: A retaining wall made of treated timber poles set in the ground with timber boards behind them.

examples.en: A timber pole wall is the cheapest option for this bank.
examples.zh: 这个土坡用木桩挡土墙最便宜。

words.note: 新西兰住宅和道路边常见的挡土墙形式。

words.zh: 石笼（装满石头的铁丝网箱）
words.definition: A wire cage filled with rocks, stacked to form walls or protect banks from erosion.

examples.en: The stream bank is protected with two rows of gabions.
examples.zh: 溪岸用两排石笼保护。

words.zh: 格构挡土墙（框格内填石的挡墙）
words.definition: A retaining wall made of interlocking timber or concrete beams with the gaps filled with rock or soil.

examples.en: The old crib wall is rotting and needs replacing.
examples.zh: 旧的格构挡墙在腐烂，需要更换。

words.zh: 加筋土挡墙
words.definition: Mechanically stabilised earth wall: compacted fill held together by layers of geogrid or steel strips, with a facing.

examples.en: The ramp is an MSE wall with precast panels on the face.
examples.zh: 这个坡道是加筋土挡墙，面板是预制板。

words.zh: 土钉（打入坡体的钢筋加固）
words.definition: A steel bar drilled and grouted into a slope or cut face to hold it in place.

examples.en: The cut face will be stabilised with soil nails and shotcrete.
examples.zh: 挖方坡面用土钉和喷射混凝土加固。

words.zh: 锚杆（锚索）
words.definition: A steel tendon or bar grouted deep into the ground and tensioned to hold a wall or slope.

examples.en: Each ground anchor gets load-tested before it's locked off.
examples.zh: 每根锚杆锁定前都要做荷载试验。

words.zh: 钢板桩（打入地下的互锁钢板墙）
words.definition: Interlocking steel sheets driven into the ground to hold back soil or water.

examples.en: We'll use sheet piling to keep the river out while we build the pier.
examples.zh: 建桥墩时我们用钢板桩挡住河水。

words.zh: 预制（在工厂浇好再运到现场安装）
words.definition: Made in a factory or yard and brought to site ready to install.

examples.en: The beams are precast in the yard and craned in overnight.
examples.zh: 梁在预制场浇好，晚上吊装。

words.zh: 现浇（在现场浇筑）
words.definition: Cast in place on site, rather than made somewhere else.

examples.en: The manholes are precast but the headwall is in-situ.
examples.zh: 检查井是预制的，但端墙是现浇的。

words.note: 源自拉丁语 in situ（原地）；工程上 cast in-situ = 现浇。

words.zh: 喷射混凝土
words.definition: Concrete sprayed through a hose at high speed onto a surface such as a slope or tunnel.

examples.en: Two layers of shotcrete went on the cut face.
examples.zh: 挖方坡面喷了两层喷射混凝土。

words.zh: 灌浆（水泥浆，填缝或灌孔）
words.definition: A runny mix of cement and water, sometimes with sand, used to fill gaps, ducts and holes.

examples.en: Grout under the bearing plates once they're levelled.
examples.zh: 支座钢板调平后在下面灌浆。

words.zh: 桥台（桥两端支撑的结构）
words.definition: The structure at each end of a bridge that supports the deck and holds back the approach embankment.

examples.en: The north abutment is poured; the south one is waiting on piles.
examples.zh: 北桥台已浇筑，南桥台在等桩。

words.zh: 桥墩（桥中间的支撑）
words.definition: A support under a bridge between its two ends, often standing in the river.

examples.en: The middle pier was damaged by debris in the flood.
examples.zh: 中间桥墩在洪水中被漂浮物撞坏了。

words.note: 港口的 pier 是“码头”，桥梁的 pier 是“桥墩”。

words.zh: 桥面（车辆通行的桥面板）
words.definition: The top surface of a bridge that carries the road or path.

examples.en: The deck will be waterproofed before the asphalt goes on.
examples.zh: 铺沥青前桥面要做防水。

words.zh: 梁
words.definition: A long horizontal structural member that carries loads across a gap.

examples.en: Each span uses four precast beams.
examples.zh: 每跨用四根预制梁。

words.zh: 大梁（主梁）
words.definition: A large main beam, often steel or concrete, that carries a bridge deck.

examples.en: The steel girders arrive on oversize trucks with an escort.
examples.zh: 钢主梁由超宽卡车运来，有护送车辆。

words.zh: 跨（两个支撑之间的距离或部分）
words.definition: The distance or section of a bridge between two supports.

examples.en: It's a three-span bridge, about sixty metres long.
examples.zh: 这是一座三跨的桥，长约六十米。

words.zh: 桥梁支座（梁和墩台之间允许变形的垫块）
words.definition: A pad or device between the beams and the piers or abutments that lets the bridge move slightly.

examples.en: The rubber bearings on the old bridge have split and need replacing.
examples.zh: 旧桥的橡胶支座裂了，需要更换。

words.zh: 伸缩缝（桥面接缝，允许热胀冷缩）
words.definition: A gap in a bridge deck or slab that lets the structure expand and contract with temperature.

examples.en: The expansion joint is banging every time a truck goes over.
examples.zh: 每次卡车经过伸缩缝都砰砰响。

words.zh: 翼墙（桥台或涵洞两侧斜伸的挡墙）
words.definition: A wall that angles out from an abutment or culvert end to hold back the bank.

examples.en: Pour the wingwalls with the headwall in one go.
examples.zh: 翼墙和端墙一次浇筑。

words.zh: 防撞护栏（桥上或路边的混凝土或钢护栏）
words.definition: A strong concrete or steel rail along the edge of a bridge or road that stops vehicles going over.

examples.en: The bridge barrier has to meet the current crash standard.
examples.zh: 桥梁防撞护栏必须满足现行的碰撞标准。

words.zh: 后张法预应力（浇筑后张拉钢绞线）
words.definition: Tightening steel cables inside hardened concrete to compress it and make it stronger.

examples.en: The post-tensioning crew stresses the deck after the 7-day results.
examples.zh: 7天强度出来后，后张拉班组张拉桥面。

words.zh: 抗震的（与地震相关）
words.definition: Related to earthquakes, as in seismic design or seismic strengthening.

examples.en: The old bridge needs seismic strengthening.
examples.zh: 旧桥需要抗震加固。

words.note: 新西兰地震多发，seismic 几乎出现在所有结构设计里。

words.zh: 测量员
words.definition: A person who measures land and sets out where things are to be built, using instruments such as GPS and total stations.

examples.en: Get the surveyor to check the pegs before we start digging.
examples.zh: 开挖前让测量员复核一下桩位。

words.note: 新西兰 surveyor 一般指测量员；cadastral surveyor 负责地界产权测量。

words.zh: 放样（把图纸上的位置标到现场）
words.definition: Marking the positions and levels from the drawings onto the ground, usually with pegs and paint.

examples.en: The set-out for the new kerb line is done; you can start boxing.
examples.zh: 新路缘线的放样完成了，可以开始立模。

words.note: 动词写 set out（两个词），名词常写 set-out 或 setout。

words.zh: 桩（测量用的木桩标记）
words.definition: A wooden stake hammered into the ground with marks showing a position, level or cut and fill.

examples.en: Somebody's knocked out the pegs on the corner again.
examples.zh: 又有人把拐角的测量桩撞掉了。

words.note: peg 上常写 C（cut，挖）或 F（fill，填）加数字。

words.zh: 偏移桩（放在施工范围外，标注偏移距离）
words.definition: A peg placed a set distance away from the actual point so it won't be disturbed by the work.

examples.en: The offset pegs are two metres back from the kerb line.
examples.zh: 偏移桩在路缘线后两米。

words.zh: 地界桩
words.definition: A survey mark showing the legal corner or line of a property.

examples.en: Don't disturb the boundary pegs; it costs a lot to have them reinstated.
examples.zh: 别动地界桩，重新恢复要花很多钱。

words.zh: 水准点（已知高程的参考点）
words.definition: A fixed point with a known height that surveyors use to set and check levels.

examples.en: All levels on this job are taken from the benchmark by the gate.
examples.zh: 这个项目的所有标高都以大门旁的水准点为准。

words.note: 缩写 BM；IT 里的 benchmark（基准测试）是另一个意思。

words.zh: 高程（reduced level，相对于基准面的高度）
words.definition: Reduced level: the height of a point above a fixed datum, written on drawings like RL 12.350.

examples.en: The finished floor is at RL 14.20.
examples.zh: 完成地面标高是14.20。

words.note: 读作字母 R-L；高程单位是米，通常到毫米（小数点后三位）。

words.zh: 基准面（高程或坐标的参考面）
words.definition: The reference surface or point that all levels or coordinates on a project are measured from.

examples.en: Make sure the drawings and the model are on the same datum.
examples.zh: 确保图纸和模型用的是同一个基准面。

words.note: 新西兰现行国家高程基准是 NZVD2016；旧项目可能用当地基准，混用会导致标高差。

words.zh: 标高/高程（某点的高度）
words.definition: The height of a point, or an instrument for measuring heights.

examples.en: What's the level at the top of the manhole?
examples.zh: 检查井顶部的标高是多少？

words.note: take levels = 测标高；on level = 标高正确；也指水准仪。

words.zh: 设计标高
words.definition: The height a surface is supposed to be built to, as shown on the drawings or model.

examples.en: We're 50 mm above design level, so trim it down.
examples.zh: 我们比设计标高高了50毫米，修下去。

words.zh: 原地面（施工前的地面）
words.definition: The natural ground surface before any work, often shown as EG on drawings.

examples.en: The long section shows existing ground as a dashed line.
examples.zh: 纵断面图用虚线表示原地面。

words.note: 缩写 EG 或 NGL（natural ground level）。

words.zh: 完成面标高
words.definition: The final height of a surface once all work is complete.

examples.en: Finished level at the vehicle crossing must match the footpath.
examples.zh: 车道出入口的完成面标高必须和人行道齐平。

words.note: 缩写 FL 或 FSL（finished surface level）；注意 FL 也可能指 formation level，看图例。

words.zh: 桩号（沿路线中线的里程距离）
words.definition: The distance along a road or pipe centreline from a starting point, used to locate things.

examples.en: The soft spot is at chainage 1250.
examples.zh: 软点在桩号1250处。

words.note: 常写作 CH 1250 或 1+250；美国叫 stationing。

words.zh: 坡度（也指“到设计标高”）
words.definition: The slope of a surface or pipe; also the design level, as in 'bring it up to grade'.

examples.en: The pipe is laid at a grade of one percent.
examples.zh: 管道按1%的坡度铺设。

words.note: on grade = 标高/坡度正确；grade 作动词 = 用平地机刮平。

words.zh: 坡度（坡度比例）
words.definition: How steep a slope is, given as a percentage or ratio.

examples.en: The driveway gradient can't be steeper than one in five.
examples.zh: 车道坡度不能陡于1:5。

words.zh: 落差/排水坡度（管道或地面向下的坡）
words.definition: The downward slope of a pipe or surface that lets water run off.

examples.en: There's not enough fall on this pipe; water will sit in it.
examples.zh: 这根管的坡度不够，水会积在里面。

words.note: 现场常说 It's got fall / There's no fall，意思是有没有排水坡度。

words.zh: 全站仪
words.definition: A surveying instrument that measures angles and distances electronically to fix positions.

examples.en: Set the total station up on the control point by the shed.
examples.zh: 把全站仪架在棚子旁边的控制点上。

words.zh: 卫星定位（测量和机械引导用）
words.definition: Satellite positioning used by surveyors and machines to know exactly where they are.

examples.en: The rover's lost its GPS fix under the trees.
examples.zh: 在树下面移动站丢失了卫星信号。

words.note: 专业上更准确叫 GNSS（包括多国卫星系统），现场习惯说 GPS。

words.zh: 机械引导（挖机/推土机按3D模型自动控制标高）
words.definition: GPS or laser systems on excavators, dozers and graders that guide the blade or bucket to design levels.

examples.en: With machine control, the operator can trim to level without pegs.
examples.zh: 有了机械引导，操作员不用测量桩也能修到标高。

words.zh: 设计模型（机械引导用的三维地形数据）
words.definition: The 3D digital surface of the design that machine control and surveyors work from.

examples.en: Upload the latest design model to all the machines tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚把最新的设计模型上传到所有机械上。

words.zh: 无人机测量
words.definition: Taking aerial photos or scans with a drone to map a site and measure volumes.

examples.en: The weekly drone survey tells us how much fill has gone in.
examples.zh: 每周的无人机测量能告诉我们填了多少方。

words.zh: 测量采集（实测现场现有物体的位置和标高）
words.definition: Surveying existing features, such as pipes, kerbs or ground levels, to record exactly where they are.

examples.en: Do a pick-up of the manhole lids before we design the connection.
examples.zh: 设计接驳前先实测一下检查井盖。

words.note: 动词形式 pick up：pick up the existing services。

words.zh: 竣工图（记录实际建成情况的图纸和数据）
words.definition: A drawing or survey that shows exactly what was built and where, including any changes from the design.

examples.en: The council won't accept the pipes without as-builts.
examples.zh: 没有竣工资料，市政不会接收这些管道。

words.note: 常用复数 as-builts；地下管线的 as-built 对日后维护和资产系统非常重要。

words.zh: 平面图
words.definition: A drawing that shows something from directly above.

examples.en: The plan view shows the pipe, but you need the long section for depths.
examples.zh: 平面图显示管线位置，但深度要看纵断面图。

words.zh: 纵断面图（沿路线或管线方向的剖面）
words.definition: A drawing along the length of a road or pipe showing ground levels, design levels and depths.

examples.en: Check the long section for the invert levels at each manhole.
examples.zh: 在纵断面图上查每个检查井的管底标高。

words.note: 缩写 LS 或 long-sec。

words.zh: 横断面图（垂直于路线的剖面）
words.definition: A drawing that shows a slice across a road or structure at one point.

examples.en: The cross section at chainage 200 shows a one in two batter.
examples.zh: 桩号200的横断面显示1:2的边坡。

words.zh: 标准横断面（典型断面图）
words.definition: A cross section showing the standard layers and dimensions used along most of a road.

examples.en: The typical section has 150 mm basecourse on 250 mm sub-base.
examples.zh: 标准断面是250毫米底基层上铺150毫米基层。

words.zh: 大样图（局部放大的详图）
words.definition: A large-scale drawing of a small part, such as a kerb outlet or manhole connection.

examples.en: Look at detail 4 on sheet 12 for the subsoil drain.
examples.zh: 盲沟看第12张图上的大样4。

words.zh: 施工版图纸（正式批准可施工）
words.definition: Issued for Construction: the approved drawing set that the site is allowed to build from.

examples.en: Only build from IFC drawings, not the tender set.
examples.zh: 只能按施工版图纸施工，不能按投标图。

words.note: 读作字母 I-F-C；注意 BIM 领域 IFC 还是一种模型文件格式（Industry Foundation Classes），含义不同。

words.zh: 版本（图纸修订号）
words.definition: A numbered or lettered update to a drawing, shown in its title block.

examples.en: You're working off revision B; revision D came out last week.
examples.zh: 你用的是B版，D版上周就出了。

words.note: 常缩写 Rev，如 Rev C；用旧版本施工是常见出错原因。

words.zh: 图签（图纸角落的标题栏）
words.definition: The box on a drawing that shows its title, number, revision, scale, date and who checked it.

examples.en: The title block says it's still a preliminary drawing.
examples.zh: 图签显示这还是初步图纸。

words.zh: 批注（在图纸上的标记修改）
words.definition: Notes and changes drawn onto a drawing by hand or in software.

examples.en: Send the engineer a markup of where the pipe actually went.
examples.zh: 给工程师发一份管线实际位置的批注图。

words.note: 现场也说 redline / red-line drawings，指用红笔标出的变更。

words.zh: 比例（图纸比例）
words.definition: The ratio between a drawing and real size, such as 1:200.

examples.en: Don't scale off the drawing; use the dimensions.
examples.zh: 不要在图纸上量比例，用标注的尺寸。

words.note: scale off the drawing = 用尺子在图上量距离，通常不被允许。

words.zh: 图纸套（一整套图纸）
words.definition: All the drawings for a project or stage, issued together.

examples.en: The new drawing set has the revised stormwater layout.
examples.zh: 新图纸套里有修改后的雨水布置。

words.zh: 总体布置图
words.definition: A drawing that shows the overall layout of a structure or site and how its parts fit together.

examples.en: Start with the general arrangement, then go to the details.
examples.zh: 先看总体布置图，再看大样。

words.note: 常缩写 GA，如 GA drawing。

words.zh: 等高线
words.definition: A line on a plan joining points of the same height.

examples.en: The contours show the site falls about four metres to the stream.
examples.zh: 等高线显示场地向溪流方向下降约四米。

words.zh: 坐标
words.definition: Numbers that give the exact position of a point, such as eastings and northings.

examples.en: Send me the coordinates of the new manholes.
examples.zh: 把新检查井的坐标发给我。

words.note: 新西兰坐标常用 easting（东坐标）和 northing（北坐标）。

words.zh: 允许偏差（容许误差范围）
words.definition: How far a measurement can be from the design and still be acceptable.

examples.en: The tolerance on the basecourse level is plus or minus 10 mm.
examples.zh: 基层标高的允许偏差是正负10毫米。

words.zh: 控制点（测量用的已知坐标点）
words.definition: A fixed survey mark with known coordinates and level that other measurements are based on.

examples.en: The digger took out a control point, so the surveyor has to re-establish it.
examples.zh: 挖机把一个控制点挖掉了，测量员得重新建立。

words.zh: 激光水准仪
words.definition: An instrument that sends out a level laser beam so workers can check heights quickly.

examples.en: Set up the laser level to check the pipe grade.
examples.zh: 架好激光水准仪检查管道坡度。

words.zh: 拉线（用于控制直线和标高的细绳）
words.definition: A tight string between pegs used as a guide for line and level.

examples.en: Run a string line along the kerb before you pour.
examples.zh: 浇筑前沿路缘拉一条线。

words.zh: 方量（土方体积）
words.definition: The amount of material, in cubic metres, to be cut, filled or moved.

examples.en: The survey shows we've moved about 30,000 cubes so far.
examples.zh: 测量显示到目前为止我们已经挖运了约三万方。

words.note: 现场把立方米叫 cubes 或 cubic metres（缩写 m³）。

words.zh: 健康与安全（health and safety 缩写）
words.definition: Short for health and safety: keeping people from getting hurt or sick at work.

examples.en: H&S is the first item on every site meeting agenda.
examples.zh: 健康安全是每次工地会议的第一项议程。

words.note: 读作 H and S；也写作 HSE（加环境）或 HSEQ（再加质量）。

words.zh: 2015年健康与安全工作法（新西兰）
words.definition: The Health and Safety at Work Act 2015, New Zealand's main workplace safety law.

examples.en: Under HSWA, everyone on site has duties, not just the boss.
examples.zh: 根据健康与安全工作法，工地上每个人都有责任，不只是老板。

words.note: 读作字母 H-S-W-A 或说全称；新西兰所有工地安全制度都以此为基础。

words.zh: 经营或从事业务的人（新西兰安全法中的责任主体）
words.definition: Person conducting a business or undertaking: the legal term in New Zealand safety law for an organisation with safety duties.

examples.en: The client, the main contractor and every subbie are all PCBUs on this site.
examples.zh: 业主、总包和每个分包在这个工地上都是责任主体。

words.note: 新西兰法律用语，通常指公司而不是个人；多个 PCBU 需要相互沟通协调（overlapping duties）。

words.zh: 个人防护装备
words.definition: Personal protective equipment, such as hard hats, hi-vis, boots, glasses and gloves.

examples.en: Full PPE past this point, no exceptions.
examples.zh: 过了这里必须穿戴全套防护装备，没有例外。

words.note: 读作字母 P-P-E。

words.zh: 反光衣（高可见度服装）
words.definition: Bright fluorescent clothing with reflective strips so workers can be seen easily.

examples.en: Night works need long-sleeved hi-vis with reflective tape.
examples.zh: 夜间施工需要有反光条的长袖反光衣。

words.note: 是 high-visibility 的口语简称，可以当名词用：Where's your hi-vis?

words.zh: 安全帽
words.definition: A strong protective helmet worn on site to protect the head.

examples.en: Hard hats on once you're past the site office.
examples.zh: 过了工地办公室就要戴安全帽。

words.zh: 钢头鞋（安全鞋）
words.definition: Safety boots with a steel toe to protect the feet.

examples.en: No steel caps, no access; that's site rules.
examples.zh: 不穿安全鞋不能进场，这是工地规定。

words.note: NZ/Aus 口语，全称 steel-capped boots；美国说 steel-toe boots。

words.zh: 护目镜（安全眼镜）
words.definition: Protective glasses that stop dust and flying bits from hitting the eyes.

examples.en: Safety glasses are compulsory when you're cutting.
examples.zh: 切割时必须戴护目镜。

words.zh: 听力保护（耳罩或耳塞）
words.definition: Earmuffs or earplugs worn in noisy areas.

examples.en: Wear hearing protection near the rock breaker.
examples.zh: 在破碎锤附近要戴听力保护装置。

words.zh: 入场安全培训
words.definition: A briefing every new worker or visitor must do before entering a site, covering hazards, rules and emergency procedures.

examples.en: Nobody starts work until they've done the site induction.
examples.zh: 没做入场培训的人不能开工。
