words.note: IT 人员第一次去工地也需要做 induction，通常还要签到。

words.zh: 签到（进出工地登记）
words.definition: To record your name and time when you arrive at site, often on an app or tablet.

examples.en: Sign in at the gate so we know who's on site in an emergency.
examples.zh: 在门口签到，这样紧急情况下我们知道谁在工地。

words.note: 离开时要 sign out；紧急疏散时用签到记录点名。

words.zh: 班前安全短会（简短安全讨论）
words.definition: A short, informal safety talk with the crew about a specific hazard or recent incident.

examples.en: This week's toolbox talk is about working near live traffic.
examples.zh: 这周的安全短会讲的是在通行车辆附近作业。

words.zh: 开工前会议（每天开工前的班组会）
words.definition: A short meeting at the start of each day to go over the work, hazards and plan.

examples.en: Pre-start is at 7 sharp in the smoko shed.
examples.zh: 开工前会议七点整在休息棚开。

words.note: 现场常简称 pre-start；也指设备开工前检查（plant pre-start check）。

words.zh: 工地专项安全计划
words.definition: Site-specific safety plan: the document setting out the hazards, controls and emergency procedures for one particular site.

examples.en: The SSSP has to be approved before we mobilise.
examples.zh: 进场前工地专项安全计划必须获批。

words.note: 读作字母 S-S-S-P。

words.zh: 作业安全分析（逐步列出风险和控制措施）
words.definition: Job safety analysis: a step-by-step list of a task, the hazards in each step and how they will be controlled.

examples.en: Write up a JSA for the night-time pipe connection.
examples.zh: 为夜间接管作业写一份作业安全分析。

words.note: 新西兰也常叫 TA（task analysis）或 JSEA，内容类似。

words.zh: 五分钟风险评估（开工前快速自查）
words.definition: A quick personal check before starting a task: stop, look, assess the hazards, control them, then go.

examples.en: Do a Take 5 before you jump in that trench.
examples.zh: 进那个沟之前先做个五分钟风险评估。

words.zh: 危险源（可能造成伤害的东西）
words.definition: Anything that could hurt someone, such as moving plant, deep trenches or live power lines.

examples.en: The biggest hazard on this job is people working near moving plant.
examples.zh: 这个项目最大的危险源是人员在移动的机械附近作业。

words.zh: 风险（伤害发生的可能性和严重程度）
words.definition: The chance that a hazard will actually hurt someone, and how badly.

examples.en: The risk is high, so we need better controls, not just a sign.
examples.zh: 风险很高，所以需要更好的控制措施，而不只是一块牌子。

words.note: hazard 是危险源本身，risk 是它造成伤害的可能性和后果。

words.zh: 风险登记表
words.definition: A list of the known risks on a site or project, with their rating and the controls in place.

examples.en: Add the overhead lines to the risk register.
examples.zh: 把架空电线加到风险登记表里。

words.zh: 关键风险（可能致死或致残的风险）
words.definition: A risk that could kill or seriously injure someone, such as mobile plant, excavations or working at height.

examples.en: Our critical risks each have their own minimum standard.
examples.zh: 我们的每项关键风险都有自己的最低标准。

words.zh: 控制措施
words.definition: The things put in place to reduce a risk, such as barriers, training, permits and PPE.

examples.en: PPE is the last line of defence; look for better controls first.
examples.zh: 个人防护是最后一道防线，先找更好的控制措施。

words.note: hierarchy of controls（控制层级）：消除 > 替代 > 隔离 > 工程控制 > 管理控制 > PPE。

words.zh: 未遂事件（差点出事但没人受伤）
words.definition: An event that could have hurt someone or damaged something but didn't.

examples.en: Report every near miss; it's how we stop the next real accident.
examples.zh: 每个未遂事件都要上报，这是防止下次真出事的方法。

words.zh: 事件/事故（造成或可能造成伤害、损失的事情）
words.definition: Any event that causes or could cause injury, illness or damage on site.

examples.en: Fill in an incident report before you go home.
examples.zh: 回家前填好事件报告。

words.zh: 误工伤害（伤者至少缺勤一班）
words.definition: A work injury that means the person can't work their next shift.

examples.en: We've gone 300 days without a lost time injury.
examples.zh: 我们已经连续300天没有误工伤害了。

words.note: 缩写 LTI；常用来计算安全指标 LTIFR（误工伤害频率）。

words.zh: 须申报事件（必须向 WorkSafe 报告的严重事件）
words.definition: In New Zealand, a death, serious injury, serious illness or dangerous incident that must be reported to WorkSafe.

examples.en: It's a notifiable event, so don't disturb the scene until WorkSafe says so.
examples.zh: 这是须申报事件，WorkSafe 同意之前不要破坏现场。

words.note: 新西兰法律用语；发生后必须尽快通知 WorkSafe 并保护现场。

words.zh: 新西兰工作安全局（职业安全监管机构）
words.definition: New Zealand's government regulator for health and safety at work.

examples.en: A WorkSafe inspector turned up for a spot check yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天 WorkSafe 的检查员来做了突击检查。

words.note: 全称 WorkSafe New Zealand（毛利语 Mahi Haumaru Aotearoa）。

words.zh: 上锁挂牌（隔离能源并上锁标识）
words.definition: Isolating machinery or power and putting personal locks and tags on it so nobody can turn it on while someone is working.

examples.en: Lockout tagout before anyone goes into the pump well.
examples.zh: 任何人进入泵井前都要上锁挂牌。

words.note: 缩写 LOTO；每个作业人员挂自己的锁。

words.zh: 隔离（切断电、水、压力等能源）
words.definition: Making equipment or a service safe by cutting off its power, pressure or flow.

examples.en: Get a power isolation from the network company before we dig near the cable.
examples.zh: 在电缆附近开挖前，先让电网公司断电隔离。

words.zh: 受限空间（检查井、罐体等通风差的空间）
words.definition: An enclosed space, such as a manhole, tank or pipe, with limited entry and a risk of bad air.

examples.en: Manhole entry is a confined space job; you need a permit and a gas detector.
examples.zh: 进入检查井属于受限空间作业，需要许可证和气体检测仪。

words.zh: 气体检测仪
words.definition: A device that warns of low oxygen or toxic or flammable gas.

examples.en: Bump test the gas detector before you go down the manhole.
examples.zh: 下检查井前对气体检测仪做冲击测试。

words.zh: 高处作业
words.definition: Any work where a person could fall and be hurt, such as on scaffolds, ladders or near open edges.

examples.en: Working at height on the bridge needs edge protection or harnesses.
examples.zh: 桥上高处作业需要临边防护或安全带。

words.zh: 临边防护（防坠落的护栏）
words.definition: Rails or barriers along an open edge to stop people falling.

examples.en: Put edge protection around the pump station wet well.
examples.zh: 在泵站集水井周围加临边防护。

words.zh: 安全带（全身式防坠落安全带）
words.definition: A set of straps worn on the body and clipped to an anchor to stop a fall.

examples.en: Clip your harness on before you lean over the edge.
examples.zh: 探身出去之前先把安全带挂上。

words.zh: 开挖安全
words.definition: Keeping people safe in and around trenches and pits, mainly by preventing collapse and falls.

examples.en: Excavation safety is one of our biggest critical risks.
examples.zh: 开挖安全是我们最大的关键风险之一。

words.zh: 沟槽支护箱（防塌方的钢箱）
words.definition: A strong steel box placed in a trench to protect workers if the sides collapse.

examples.en: Nobody goes in the trench until the trench shield is in.
examples.zh: 沟槽支护箱放好之前谁都不准下沟。

words.note: 也叫 trench box；广义的支护叫 shoring。

words.zh: 支护（防止沟壁或基坑坍塌的支撑）
words.definition: Supports used to hold up the sides of an excavation or a structure.

examples.en: The deep excavation needs engineered shoring.
examples.zh: 深基坑需要经过设计的支护。

words.zh: 隔离区（禁止人员进入的区域）
words.definition: An area around a hazard, such as a crane lift or working machine, that people must not enter.

examples.en: Keep out of the exclusion zone while the beam is being lifted.
examples.zh: 吊梁时不要进入隔离区。

words.zh: 指挥员/观察员（为机械操作员看护）
words.definition: A person who watches and guides a machine operator so the machine doesn't hit people, services or power lines.

examples.en: You'll need a spotter when you're digging near the gas main.
examples.zh: 在燃气主管附近开挖时需要一个看护员。

words.zh: 人机隔离
words.definition: Keeping workers on foot physically apart from moving machinery.

examples.en: People-plant separation is the number one rule on this site.
examples.zh: 人机隔离是这个工地的第一条规矩。

words.note: plant 在这里指施工机械，不是植物。

words.zh: 作业许可证
words.definition: A written approval needed before high-risk work, such as confined space entry or hot work.

examples.en: Hot works need a permit to work signed by the supervisor.
examples.zh: 动火作业需要主管签字的作业许可证。

words.zh: 开挖许可
words.definition: A site approval confirming services have been located and it is safe to start digging in a certain area.

examples.en: No permit to dig, no digging. Simple as that.
examples.zh: 没有开挖许可就不准挖，就这么简单。

words.zh: 地下管线（电、气、水、通讯等）
words.definition: Pipes and cables buried in the ground, such as power, gas, water, fibre and telecommunications.

examples.en: Assume there are underground services until you've proven there aren't.
examples.zh: 在证实没有之前，要假定地下有管线。

words.note: 现场简称 services；挖断光缆或燃气管是最常见的严重事故之一。

words.zh: 管线图（各管线单位提供的地下设施位置图）
words.definition: Maps from utility owners showing where their pipes and cables are, requested before digging.

examples.en: Get the service plans before the job starts, and keep them in the ute.
examples.zh: 开工前拿到管线图，放在皮卡里。

words.zh: 管线探测定位（现场探测并标出管线）
words.definition: Finding and marking buried services on the ground, usually with detectors and spray paint, before digging.

examples.en: The service locate found a fibre cable not shown on the plans.
examples.zh: 管线探测发现了一条图上没有的光缆。

words.zh: 探坑（人工或真空挖小坑暴露管线）
words.definition: Digging small holes by hand or with a vacuum truck to expose buried services and confirm their depth.

examples.en: Pothole the gas main before the digger goes anywhere near it.
examples.zh: 挖机靠近燃气管之前先挖探坑确认位置。

words.note: 这里不是路面坑洞（pothole）的意思；用真空车挖叫 hydro-excavation / vac excavation。

words.zh: 架空电线
words.definition: Power or telecommunications cables strung between poles above the ground.

examples.en: Keep the boom well clear of the overhead lines.
examples.zh: 臂杆要和架空电线保持足够距离。

words.zh: 硅尘（切割混凝土石料产生的有害粉尘）
words.definition: Fine dust from cutting or grinding concrete, stone and some soils that can cause serious lung disease.

examples.en: Use the water attachment on the saw to keep the silica dust down.
examples.zh: 锯子要用加水装置来减少硅尘。

words.note: 新西兰 WorkSafe 近年重点关注的职业健康风险。

words.zh: 石棉
words.definition: A banned mineral fibre found in old pipes and buildings that can cause cancer if breathed in.

examples.en: The old water mains are asbestos cement, so they need a licensed removalist.
examples.zh: 旧供水管是石棉水泥管，需要有执照的人拆除。

words.note: 新西兰很多旧供水管是 AC pipe（asbestos cement），注意与沥青 AC 区分。

words.zh: 疲劳
words.definition: Being too tired to work safely, often from long shifts or night work.

examples.en: Watch for fatigue on the night crew in week two.
examples.zh: 第二周要注意夜班的疲劳问题。

words.zh: 毒品和酒精检测
words.definition: Testing workers for drugs or alcohol, for example before starting, at random or after an incident.

examples.en: Everyone involved in the incident had a drug and alcohol test.
examples.zh: 所有涉及事件的人都做了毒品和酒精检测。

words.zh: 集合点（紧急疏散集合地）
words.definition: The place everyone gathers in an emergency so they can be counted.

examples.en: The muster point is by the front gate.
examples.zh: 集合点在前门旁边。

words.zh: 急救员（受过急救培训的人）
words.definition: A worker trained to give first aid until medical help arrives.

examples.en: Every crew needs at least one first aider.
examples.zh: 每个班组至少要有一名急救员。

words.zh: 安全数据表（化学品的安全说明）
words.definition: Safety data sheet: a document describing the hazards of a chemical and how to handle it safely.

examples.en: Keep the SDS for the curing compound in the site office.
examples.zh: 把养护剂的安全数据表放在工地办公室。

words.zh: 停工（发现危险时叫停作业）
words.definition: To halt a task straight away because it looks unsafe; anyone on site can call it.

examples.en: Anyone can stop work if something doesn't look right.
examples.zh: 任何人觉得不对劲都可以叫停作业。

words.zh: 临时交通管理（施工期间的交通管制）
words.definition: Temporary traffic management: the signs, cones, barriers and people used to keep workers and road users safe around work on a road.

examples.en: TTM is a big part of the cost on a busy urban road.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的城市道路上，临时交通管理占了成本的一大块。

words.note: 读作字母 T-T-M；现场也简称 traffic management 或 TM。

words.zh: 交通管理计划
words.definition: Traffic management plan: the approved document that shows how traffic and pedestrians will be managed around the work.

examples.en: We can't set up until the TMP is approved.
examples.zh: 交通管理计划批准前我们不能布设。

words.note: 读作字母 T-M-P；通常要连同 CAR 一起提交给道路管理机构审批。

words.zh: 交通管理布置图
words.definition: Traffic management diagram: a drawing showing exactly where each sign, cone and barrier goes.

examples.en: Set the site up exactly as shown on the TMD.
examples.zh: 严格按照交通管理布置图布设现场。

words.zh: 现场交通管理主管（持证负责布设和管理交通管制）
words.definition: Site traffic management supervisor: the qualified person in charge of setting up and running traffic management on site.

examples.en: The STMS has to be on site whenever the closure is in place.
examples.zh: 封闭期间现场交通管理主管必须在场。

words.note: 新西兰交通管理的关键资质岗位，读作字母 S-T-M-S。

words.zh: 交通指挥员（拿停/行牌指挥车辆）
words.definition: A trained person who controls traffic on site, often with a stop/go paddle.

examples.en: We need two traffic controllers for the single-lane section.
examples.zh: 单车道路段需要两名交通指挥员。

words.note: 缩写 TC；美国叫 flagger。

words.zh: 新西兰临时交通管理实务守则
words.definition: The Code of Practice for Temporary Traffic Management, the long-standing New Zealand rules for traffic management at road works.

examples.en: The layout follows CoPTTM, but check which guidance this client wants.
examples.zh: 布置按照守则执行，但要确认这个客户要求用哪套指南。

words.note: 新西兰交通局正在把它逐步过渡到新的风险导向指南（New Zealand Guide to Temporary Traffic Management）；具体用哪套以项目要求为准。

words.zh: 停/行管制（人工举牌交替放行）
words.definition: A way of running one lane of traffic in turns, with controllers holding signs that say STOP on one side and GO on the other.

examples.en: It'll be stop/go through the bridge while we replace the joints.
examples.zh: 更换伸缩缝期间，过桥采用举牌交替放行。

words.note: 举的牌子叫 stop/go paddle 或 lollipop。

words.zh: 交通锥
words.definition: An orange plastic cone used to mark out work areas and guide traffic.

examples.en: The cones blew over in the wind; get someone to reset them.
examples.zh: 交通锥被风吹倒了，找人重新摆好。

words.note: 现场简称 cones；美国也叫 traffic cones / pylons。

words.zh: 临时护栏（混凝土或注水护栏）
words.definition: Concrete or water-filled plastic barriers placed to separate the work area from traffic.

examples.en: On the motorway we need concrete temporary barriers, not just cones.
examples.zh: 在高速上我们需要混凝土临时护栏，不能只用锥。

words.zh: 封闭车道
words.definition: Shutting one or more lanes of a road so work can be done in them.

examples.en: The lane closure can only go in after 9 am.
examples.zh: 车道封闭只能在上午九点后实施。

words.zh: 封闭路肩
words.definition: Closing the shoulder of a road to traffic while keeping the lanes open.

examples.en: It's only a shoulder closure, so traffic won't be held up much.
examples.zh: 只是封闭路肩，所以交通不会受太大影响。

words.zh: 封路
words.definition: Shutting a road completely to traffic, usually with a signed detour.

examples.en: The road closure has to be advertised in advance.
examples.zh: 封路必须提前公告。

words.zh: 绕行（改道路线）
words.definition: A different route that traffic is sent along while a road is closed.

examples.en: The detour adds about ten minutes for the buses.
examples.zh: 绕行让公交车多花大约十分钟。

words.note: 英国也说 diversion。

words.zh: 临时限速
words.definition: A lower speed limit set for a work site, shown with temporary signs.

examples.en: Keep the temporary speed limit up until the new seal has bedded in.
examples.zh: 新封层稳定之前保持临时限速。

words.note: 缩写 TSL；新封层的碎石松散时常用。

words.zh: 车载防撞缓冲车（后部带缓冲装置的卡车）
words.definition: Truck-mounted attenuator: a truck with a crash cushion on the back that protects workers from vehicles hitting the work area.

examples.en: The TMA sits behind the crew when they're working on the motorway.
examples.zh: 在高速上作业时，防撞缓冲车停在作业人员后面。

words.note: 现场也叫 attenuator truck；常停在作业人员后方，被车撞时吸收冲击。

words.zh: 前方预告标志（提前告知前方施工）
words.definition: A sign placed well before the work area to warn drivers what is ahead.

examples.en: Move the advance warning sign back; it's too close to the bend.
examples.zh: 把前方预告标志往后移，离弯道太近了。

words.zh: 渐变段（用锥形成斜线引导车辆变道）
words.definition: A diagonal line of cones that guides traffic smoothly out of a closed lane.

examples.en: The taper needs to be longer on a 100 km/h road.
examples.zh: 在限速100的路上渐变段要更长。

words.zh: 可变信息标志（电子显示屏）
words.definition: An electronic sign that can show different messages, used to warn drivers about works or closures.

examples.en: Put the variable message sign out a week before the closure.
examples.zh: 封路前一周放出可变信息标志。

words.note: 缩写 VMS。

words.zh: 移动式红绿灯
words.definition: Temporary traffic lights on trailers or stands used to control one-lane sections.

examples.en: Overnight we'll swap the controllers for portable traffic signals.
examples.zh: 夜间我们用移动式红绿灯代替人工指挥。

words.zh: 道路走廊（道路用地范围，含路面、人行道、绿地）
words.definition: All the land within a road's legal boundary, including the carriageway, footpaths and berms.

examples.en: Any work in the road corridor needs approval from the road controlling authority.
examples.zh: 在道路走廊内的任何施工都需要道路管理机构批准。

words.zh: 道路占用申请（在道路范围施工的申请）
words.definition: Corridor access request: the application to a road controlling authority for permission to work in the road corridor.

examples.en: Lodge the CAR early; approval can take a few weeks.
examples.zh: 道路占用申请要早点提交，审批可能要几周。

words.note: 新西兰用语，读作字母 C-A-R；批准后会发 WAP（Works Access Permit）。

words.zh: 施工进入许可（CAR 批准后发的许可）
words.definition: Works access permit: the approval issued in response to a corridor access request, with conditions for the work.

examples.en: Check the WAP conditions; they might not allow night works.
examples.zh: 查一下许可条件，可能不允许夜间施工。

words.zh: 道路管理机构（市政或国家交通局）
words.definition: Road controlling authority: the organisation responsible for a road, usually the local council or the national transport agency.

examples.en: The RCA wants the road reopened by 6 every morning.
examples.zh: 道路管理机构要求每天早上六点前恢复通车。

words.zh: 道路走廊管理员（审批道路施工的人员）
words.definition: The person at a road controlling authority who manages and approves work in the road corridor.

examples.en: Ring the corridor manager and ask if we can extend the closure.
examples.zh: 给走廊管理员打电话，问能不能延长封闭时间。

words.zh: 行人管理（施工时保障行人通行）
words.definition: Arrangements that keep people walking safe and able to get past a work site, including wheelchair and pram users.

examples.en: Pedestrian management is as important as the traffic; don't send people onto the road.
examples.zh: 行人管理和车辆管理一样重要，别让行人走到马路上。

words.zh: 临时人行道
words.definition: A safe, marked path set up for pedestrians while the normal footpath is closed.

examples.en: Build a temporary footpath with mats and barriers along the fence.
examples.zh: 沿着围栏用垫板和护栏搭一条临时人行道。

words.zh: 夜间施工
words.definition: Work done at night to avoid heavy daytime traffic.

examples.en: The intersection will be done as night works over three weeks.
examples.zh: 这个交叉口会在三周内以夜间施工方式完成。

words.zh: 非高峰时段
words.definition: Times of day when traffic is lighter, outside the morning and evening rush.

examples.en: Lane closures are only allowed off-peak.
examples.zh: 车道封闭只允许在非高峰时段进行。

words.zh: 有人值守（现场有人管理的交通管制）
words.definition: Describes traffic management while workers are on site; unattended means the setup is left in place with nobody there.

examples.en: At knock-off we change it from an attended to an unattended site.
examples.zh: 收工时我们把它从有人值守转为无人值守布置。

words.note: unattended 布置通常需要更多护栏、照明和标志，因为没有人在现场。

words.zh: 作业区
words.definition: The part of the road closed off where the actual work is happening.

examples.en: Nobody parks inside the work zone.
examples.zh: 任何人都不能在作业区内停车。

words.zh: 安全区（作业区与车流之间的缓冲空间）
words.definition: A clear space between the traffic and the work area that gives drivers room for error.

examples.en: Don't put materials in the safety zone; it has to stay clear.
examples.zh: 不要把材料放在安全区，必须保持畅通。

words.zh: 现场工程师
words.definition: An engineer based on site who checks the work is built to the drawings and handles day-to-day technical issues.

examples.en: The site engineer will check the levels before we pour.
examples.zh: 现场工程师会在浇筑前检查标高。

words.zh: 现场经理（工地负责人）
words.definition: The person in charge of everything happening on a site day to day.

examples.en: Talk to the site manager before you bring any visitors on site.
examples.zh: 带访客进场前先和现场经理说。

words.zh: 现场主管
words.definition: A person who directs the crews and checks the work on site, usually reporting to the site manager.

examples.en: The site supervisor signs off the daily diary.
examples.zh: 现场主管签批每日施工日志。

words.zh: 工长（带领一个或几个班组的负责人）
words.definition: An experienced worker who leads one or more crews and organises the daily work.

examples.en: The foreman decides who's on the pipe crew tomorrow.
examples.zh: 工长决定明天谁在管道班组。

words.note: 复数 foremen；有时也用中性的 supervisor。

words.zh: 领班（带头干活的班组长）
words.definition: A senior worker who leads a small crew while still working alongside them.

examples.en: Ring the leading hand if the truck's running late.
examples.zh: 如果卡车晚到，给领班打电话。

words.note: NZ/Aus 说法，比 foreman 级别低。

words.zh: 班组长（道路养护班的领头）
words.definition: The leader of a gang of workers, especially on road maintenance.

examples.en: The ganger has the list of potholes for today.
examples.zh: 班组长手上有今天要补的坑洞清单。

words.zh: 施工班组（一组工人）
words.definition: A group of workers who do a particular job together, such as a pipe crew or kerb crew.

examples.en: We've got three crews on site this week.
examples.zh: 这周工地上有三个班组。

words.note: 也说 gang 或 team；crew 在新西兰工地最常用。

words.zh: 机械操作手
words.definition: A person who drives and operates a machine such as an excavator, roller or grader.

examples.en: He's the best operator we've got on the grader.
examples.zh: 他是我们平地机最好的操作手。

words.note: IT 里 operator 是“运维人员”，工地上是开机械的人。

words.zh: 普工（体力劳动工人）
words.definition: A worker who does general manual tasks on site, such as shovelling, carrying and cleaning up.

examples.en: We need two more labourers for the concrete pour.
examples.zh: 浇筑混凝土还需要两个普工。

words.note: NZ/英式拼写 labourer，美式 laborer。

words.zh: 管道工（铺管工人）
words.definition: A worker who lays and joins pipes in trenches.

examples.en: A good pipelayer can get the grade spot on first time.
examples.zh: 好的铺管工一次就能把坡度做准。

words.zh: 持证排水工（新西兰持牌安装排水管的人）
words.definition: In New Zealand, a licensed tradesperson allowed to lay and connect drains to buildings.

examples.en: Private drains have to be laid by a certifying drainlayer.
examples.zh: 私人排水管必须由持证排水工铺设。

words.note: 新西兰受监管的执业工种，需要注册和执照。

words.zh: 混凝土抹面工
words.definition: A worker who levels and finishes the surface of fresh concrete.

examples.en: Book the concrete finishers for an early start on pour day.
examples.zh: 浇筑日给抹面工安排早开工。

words.zh: 钢筋工
words.definition: A worker who cuts, places and ties reinforcing steel.

examples.en: The steel fixers will be done by lunchtime.
examples.zh: 钢筋工中午前就能干完。

words.zh: 木工（口语）
words.definition: Informal word for a carpenter, including those building formwork.

examples.en: Get the chippies to fix the boxing before the inspection.
examples.zh: 让木工在验收前把模板修好。

words.note: NZ/英国/澳洲口语，来自 carpenter 的 chip（木屑）。

words.zh: 木工助手（新西兰）
words.definition: New Zealand word for a carpenter's labourer or an apprentice-level carpenter.

examples.en: He started as a hammerhand and now runs his own formwork crew.
examples.zh: 他从木工助手干起，现在带自己的模板班组。

words.zh: 电工（口语）
words.definition: Informal word for an electrician.

examples.en: We need a sparky to disconnect the street light.
examples.zh: 需要一个电工来断开路灯。

words.note: NZ/英/澳口语，也写 sparkie。

words.zh: 起重司索工（负责吊装绑扎）
words.definition: A worker who attaches loads to cranes and directs lifts safely.

examples.en: The rigger gives the signals; nobody else talks to the crane driver.
examples.zh: 由司索工发信号，其他人不要和吊车司机说话。

words.note: NZ/Aus 也说 dogman（指挥吊装的人）。

words.zh: 工程师
words.definition: A qualified professional who designs or checks the technical side of the work.

examples.en: The engineer wants to see the base of the excavation before we backfill.
examples.zh: 工程师要在回填前看一下基坑底。

words.zh: 设计工程师
words.definition: An engineer who produces the design and drawings for a project.

examples.en: Send the question to the design engineer; it's their detail.
examples.zh: 把问题发给设计工程师，这是他们的大样。

words.zh: 岩土工程师
words.definition: An engineer who specialises in soil, rock and groundwater and how the ground will behave.

examples.en: The geotechnical engineer signed off the fill on lots 10 to 25.
examples.zh: 岩土工程师签字确认了10到25号地块的填方。

words.zh: 结构工程师
words.definition: An engineer who designs structures such as bridges, walls and slabs so they are strong and safe.

examples.en: The structural engineer has to check the change to the wall.
examples.zh: 挡墙的改动要由结构工程师复核。

words.zh: 总承包商
words.definition: The company with the main contract to build the project, which manages the subcontractors.

examples.en: As main contractor, we're responsible for the whole site.
examples.zh: 作为总包，我们对整个工地负责。

words.note: 也叫 head contractor；与业主直接签合同。

words.zh: 业主（委托方）
words.definition: The organisation paying for the project, such as a council, government agency or developer.

examples.en: The client wants the footpath open before school goes back.
examples.zh: 业主要求开学前人行道开放。

words.zh: 咨询方（设计或监理顾问公司）
words.definition: An engineering or design firm hired by the client to design, check or supervise the work.

examples.en: The consultant will review our method statement.
examples.zh: 咨询方会审查我们的施工方案。

words.zh: 开发商
words.definition: A company or person who buys land and builds subdivisions or buildings to sell.

examples.en: The developer wants the first stage titled by next winter.
examples.zh: 开发商希望一期在明年冬天前拿到产权。

words.zh: 市政检查员
words.definition: A council staff member who inspects work to check it meets consent and engineering standards.

examples.en: The council inspector is coming at 2 to look at the pipe bedding.
examples.zh: 市政检查员两点来看管道垫层。

words.zh: 毛利原住民部落（对某地区有传统权属的部落）
words.definition: The Māori iwi or hapū with traditional authority over a particular area of land.

examples.en: We'll meet with mana whenua before the earthworks near the river.
examples.zh: 在河边做土方前我们会和当地毛利部落开会。

words.note: 毛利语，wh 读作 f；许多新西兰项目要求与 mana whenua 协商。

words.zh: 文化监护员（毛利部落派来的现场观察员）
words.definition: A person appointed by mana whenua to watch earthworks and advise if culturally significant items are found.

examples.en: The cultural monitor will be on site for the topsoil strip.
examples.zh: 剥表土时文化监护员会在现场。

words.zh: 考古学家
words.definition: A specialist who studies and records historic sites and objects found during digging.

examples.en: Work stopped until the archaeologist looked at the midden.
examples.zh: 停工直到考古学家查看了那个贝丘。

words.zh: 安全顾问（安全专员）
words.definition: A person who helps the site manage health and safety, with audits, training and incident investigations.

examples.en: The H&S advisor is doing a site audit on Thursday.
examples.zh: 安全顾问周四来做现场审核。

words.zh: 环境顾问（负责环保合规）
words.definition: A person who checks the site meets its consent conditions for erosion, sediment, noise and dust.

examples.en: The environmental advisor wants the silt fence fixed today.
examples.zh: 环境顾问要求今天修好防淤围栏。

words.zh: 学徒
words.definition: A trainee learning a trade on the job while studying for a qualification.

examples.en: Our apprentices do block courses as well as site work.
examples.zh: 我们的学徒除了现场工作还要上集中课程。

words.zh: 毕业生工程师（刚毕业的工程师）
words.definition: An engineer in their first years after university, learning under senior staff.

examples.en: The graduate engineer is doing the as-built checks.
examples.zh: 毕业生工程师在做竣工核查。

words.zh: 访客
words.definition: Anyone on site who is not part of the working crews, who must be inducted and escorted.

examples.en: Visitors must be escorted at all times.
examples.zh: 访客必须全程有人陪同。

words.zh: 进场（把人员和设备调到工地，简称 mob）
words.definition: To bring people, machines and site facilities onto a site to start work.

examples.en: We'll mobilise on the 3rd and start digging the week after.
examples.zh: 我们3号进场，下周开始开挖。

words.note: 口语简称 mob（mob on site）；名词 mobilisation。NZ/英式拼写 -ise。

words.zh: 撤场（把人员和设备撤离工地，简称 demob）
words.definition: To remove people, machines and site facilities from a site when work is finished.

examples.en: Once the seal's on, we can demob the site sheds.
examples.zh: 封层铺好后，我们就可以撤走工地棚屋。

words.note: 口语 demob（DEE-mob）。

words.zh: 布设（准备好现场、设备或交通管制）
words.definition: To get the site, equipment or traffic management ready before work starts.

examples.en: The traffic crew will set up at 8:30.
examples.zh: 交通管制班组八点半开始布设。

words.note: 名词写 set-up 或 setup。

words.zh: 收工收拾（收拾设备和标志）
words.definition: To put away equipment, signs and cones at the end of the work.

examples.en: Start packing up at 3 so the road's open for the school run.
examples.zh: 三点开始收拾，这样接送孩子时路是通的。

words.zh: 收工（下班）
words.definition: Informal: to finish work for the day.

examples.en: We're knocking off early today because of the rain.
examples.zh: 因为下雨今天提早收工。

words.note: 名词 knock-off（下班时间）：What time's knock-off?

words.zh: 休息时间（工间茶歇，新西兰口语）
words.definition: New Zealand and Australian slang for a short work break for tea and food.

examples.en: Smoko's at ten; we'll talk about it then.
examples.zh: 十点茶歇，到时候再说。

words.note: NZ/Aus 口语，原义是抽烟休息，现在泛指茶歇；smoko shed / smoko room = 休息棚。

words.zh: 停工（放下工具不干了）
words.definition: To stop working, either because it's unsafe, the weather is bad or as a protest.

examples.en: If lightning comes in, everyone downs tools and gets in the sheds.
examples.zh: 如果有闪电，大家都停工进棚子。

words.zh: 决定收工（宣布今天到此为止）
words.definition: Informal: to decide to stop work for the day.

examples.en: It's pouring; let's call it for today.
examples.zh: 雨下得太大了，今天就到这儿吧。

words.note: 完整说法 call it a day。

words.zh: 雨天停工日
words.definition: A working day lost because rain made it impossible or unsafe to work.

examples.en: We've had six rain days this month already.
examples.zh: 这个月已经有六个雨天停工了。

words.note: 合同和报告里常说 wet weather day；可能影响工期延期申请。

words.zh: 因雨停工
words.definition: When work is stopped or cancelled because of rain.

examples.en: The seal crew got rained off again.
examples.zh: 封层班组又因雨停工了。

words.zh: 雨天（施工受雨影响）
words.definition: Rainy conditions that stop or slow outdoor work, especially earthworks and sealing.

examples.en: Have a wet weather plan for the crew so they're not standing around.
examples.zh: 给班组准备雨天计划，免得大家干站着。

words.zh: 浇筑日
words.definition: The day a major concrete pour happens, which needs careful planning.

examples.en: No other deliveries on pour day; the gate has to stay clear.
examples.zh: 浇筑日不安排其他送货，大门必须畅通。

words.zh: 修复恢复（把损坏处恢复原状）
words.definition: To repair anything damaged during the work so it is back to its original condition.

examples.en: Make good the lawn where the trench went through.
examples.zh: 把沟槽穿过的草坪恢复原样。

words.note: 合同和图纸常用词：make good all damage。

words.zh: 路面/场地恢复（施工后恢复原样）
words.definition: Putting a road, footpath, lawn or driveway back to its original condition after digging it up.

examples.en: Permanent reinstatement of the trench will be done in asphalt.
examples.zh: 沟槽的永久恢复将用沥青完成。

words.note: 动词 reinstate；temporary reinstatement = 临时恢复。

words.zh: 缺陷清单（收尾前要修补的小问题）
words.definition: A list of small defects and unfinished items to fix before handover.

examples.en: We've got about forty items on the snag list.
examples.zh: 缺陷清单上大约有四十项。

words.note: NZ/英式说 snag list；美式说 punch list。

words.zh: 收尾清单（美式说法）
words.definition: The American term for a list of small defects to fix before a job is finished.

examples.en: The American consultant keeps calling it a punch list.
examples.zh: 那位美国顾问一直把它叫作收尾清单。

words.note: 新西兰更常说 snag list 或 defects list。

words.zh: 签字确认（批准、验收）
words.definition: To give formal approval that something is complete or acceptable.

examples.en: The engineer has to sign off the steel before we can pour.
examples.zh: 钢筋要工程师签字确认后才能浇筑。

words.note: 名词 sign-off：We're waiting on sign-off.

words.zh: 移交（把完成的工程交给业主）
words.definition: To give completed work to the client to own and use.

examples.en: We hand over stage one at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 我们月底移交一期。

words.note: 名词 handover。

words.zh: 按计划进度（新西兰用 programme 表示工期计划）
words.definition: Running on time according to the project schedule.

examples.en: Despite the rain, we're still on programme.
examples.zh: 尽管下雨，我们还是按计划进度。

words.note: NZ/英国把施工进度计划叫 programme；美式叫 schedule。

words.zh: 进度滞后
words.definition: Running later than the project schedule.

examples.en: We're two weeks behind programme because of the wet weather.
examples.zh: 因为天气潮湿，我们比计划落后两周。

words.zh: 进度提前
words.definition: Running earlier than the project schedule.

examples.en: The bridge crew is a week ahead of programme.
examples.zh: 桥梁班组比计划提前了一周。

words.zh: 现场巡视
words.definition: Walking around the site, often with the client or engineer, to look at progress or problems.

examples.en: Let's do a site walk after the meeting to look at the batter.
examples.zh: 开完会我们去现场走一圈看看边坡。

words.note: 也叫 walkaround / walkover。

words.zh: 施工日志
words.definition: A daily record of who was on site, the weather, the work done, deliveries and any problems.

examples.en: Put the delay in the site diary in case there's a claim later.
examples.zh: 把这次延误记进施工日志，以防以后索赔。

words.zh: 工地棚屋（办公室、休息室、厕所等临时房）
words.definition: The temporary buildings on site, such as the office, smoko room and toilets.

examples.en: The site sheds go in next to the gate.
examples.zh: 工地棚屋放在门口旁边。

words.zh: 移动厕所
words.definition: A portable toilet on a work site.

examples.en: Get the portaloos serviced twice a week.
examples.zh: 移动厕所每周清理两次。

words.note: NZ/英国口语（源自品牌名，被当成通称）。

words.zh: 工地围栏（临时围挡）
words.definition: Temporary fencing around a site to keep the public out.

examples.en: Check the site fence is closed up at knock-off.
examples.zh: 收工时检查工地围栏是否关好。

words.zh: 接着干（抓紧继续干活）
words.definition: Informal: to continue or get going with work quickly.

examples.en: The inspection's passed, so crack on with the backfill.
examples.zh: 验收通过了，接着回填吧。

words.zh: 卖力干起来
words.definition: Informal: to start working hard and with energy.

examples.en: The new labourer really gets stuck in.
examples.zh: 新来的普工干活很卖力。

words.zh: 没事的（新西兰口语，有时显得太随意）
words.definition: A relaxed New Zealand saying meaning 'it will be fine'.

examples.en: 'She'll be right' isn't good enough when you're working near a live main.
examples.zh: 在在用主管附近作业时，“没事的”这种态度可不行。

words.note: 新西兰典型口语；在安全语境里常被批评为侥幸心理。

words.zh: 搞定了（口语）
words.definition: Informal: done, organised or fixed.

examples.en: The traffic plan's sorted; we're good for tomorrow.
examples.zh: 交通方案搞定了，明天没问题。

words.zh: 提前告知（提个醒）
words.definition: A warning or notice in advance.

examples.en: Just a heads up: the concrete truck's running late.
examples.zh: 提前跟你说一声：混凝土车会晚到。

words.zh: 延误（耽搁）
words.definition: A delay that stops work moving forward.

examples.en: What's the hold-up? The truck's been waiting an hour.
examples.zh: 怎么耽搁了？卡车已经等了一个小时。

words.note: 动词 hold up：The rain held us up.

words.zh: 被停工（让工人回家或停止某工作）
words.definition: When workers are told to stop work and go home, or a crew is taken off a job for now.

examples.en: The crew was stood down until the slip was made safe.
examples.zh: 在塌方处理安全前，班组被停工。

words.zh: 陷住（车辆陷在泥里，NZ/Aus 口语）
words.definition: Stuck in mud.

examples.en: The truck got bogged at the bottom of the haul road.
examples.zh: 卡车在施工便道底部陷住了。

words.note: get bogged / bogged down；bogged down 也比喻工作被拖住。

words.zh: 设备工具（口语泛指）
words.definition: Informal word for equipment, tools and machines.

examples.en: Lock all the gear in the container at night.
examples.zh: 晚上把所有工具设备锁进集装箱。

words.note: 不可数名词，不说 gears（gears 是齿轮/挡位）。

words.zh: 催办（跟进催促）
words.definition: To follow up with someone to get something done.

examples.en: Can you chase up the test results from the lab?
examples.zh: 你能去催一下实验室的检测结果吗？

words.zh: 返工
words.definition: Work that has to be done again because it was wrong the first time.

examples.en: Rework on the kerb cost us two days.
examples.zh: 路缘石返工耽误了我们两天。

words.zh: 提早开工
words.definition: Starting work earlier than usual, often for a big pour or to beat the traffic.

examples.en: Early start tomorrow; we're on site at six.
examples.zh: 明天提早开工，六点到工地。

words.zh: 长周末（周一或周五公共假日连休）
words.definition: A weekend with a public holiday on the Friday or Monday.

examples.en: Traffic management has to be off the highway for the long weekend.
examples.zh: 长周末期间交通管制必须撤离国道。

words.zh: 施工方案（说明怎么施工的文件）
words.definition: A document explaining step by step how a piece of work will be done safely and correctly.

examples.en: Send the method statement for the bridge lift to the client.
examples.zh: 把桥梁吊装的施工方案发给业主。

words.note: 新西兰也常叫 construction methodology。

words.zh: 工地会议
words.definition: A regular meeting on site with the client, engineer and contractor about progress and issues.

examples.en: Bring the updated programme to the site meeting.
examples.zh: 把更新的进度计划带到工地会议上。

words.zh: 材料堆放区（场内临时存料区）
words.definition: A part of the site set aside for storing materials and equipment.

examples.en: Put the pipes in the lay down area, not on the berm.
examples.zh: 管子放在堆料区，别放在路边草地上。

words.zh: 质量保证（检查记录体系，证明做对了）
words.definition: Quality assurance: the system of checks, tests and records that shows the work meets the specification.

examples.en: Without the QA records, the council won't take the road over.
examples.zh: 没有质量记录，市政不会接收这条路。

words.note: 现场常把整个质量资料包叫 the QA；QA 偏体系和记录，QC 偏具体检查。

words.zh: 质量控制（具体检查和测试）
words.definition: Quality control: the hands-on checks and tests done during the work to catch problems.

examples.en: The foreman does QC on every manhole before it's backfilled.
examples.zh: 每个检查井回填前工长都要做质量检查。

words.zh: 检验和试验计划
words.definition: Inspection and test plan: a list of the checks, tests, hold points and records needed for each part of the work.

examples.en: Follow the ITP for the water main; it lists every test.
examples.zh: 按供水主管的检验试验计划执行，里面列了所有试验。

words.note: 读作字母 I-T-P。

words.zh: 停止点（必须验收才能继续的节点）
words.definition: A step where work must stop until an inspection is done and approved.

examples.en: Bedding inspection is a hold point; don't backfill until it's signed off.
examples.zh: 垫层检查是停止点，签字前不准回填。

words.note: 与 witness point 不同：hold point 必须等验收；witness point 只需提前通知，对方没来可以继续。

words.zh: 见证点（需通知监理到场见证的节点）
words.definition: A step where the engineer must be told in advance and may come to watch, but work can continue if they don't.

examples.en: The pressure test is a witness point, so give the engineer 24 hours' notice.
examples.zh: 压力试验是见证点，所以要提前24小时通知工程师。

words.zh: 不合格报告
words.definition: Non-conformance report: a record that something was not built or tested to the specification, and how it will be fixed.

examples.en: We got an NCR for the low compaction results.
examples.zh: 因为压实结果偏低，我们收到了一份不合格报告。

words.note: 读作字母 N-C-R。

words.zh: 技术规范（规定材料和施工要求的文件）
words.definition: The document that says what materials, methods, tests and standards the work must meet.

examples.en: The specification calls for 95 percent compaction.
examples.zh: 技术规范要求95%的压实度。

words.note: 口语简称 spec：It's not to spec（不符合规范）。

words.zh: 检查（验收）
words.definition: A formal check of work by an engineer, inspector or supervisor.

examples.en: Book the inspection for first thing Monday.
examples.zh: 把检查约在周一一早。

words.zh: 检测结果
words.definition: The numbers or pass/fail outcome from a site or lab test.

examples.en: The test results show the basecourse is fine.
examples.zh: 检测结果显示基层没问题。

words.zh: 检测实验室
words.definition: A laboratory that tests samples of soil, aggregate, concrete and other materials.

examples.en: Drop the cylinders at the testing lab on your way back.
examples.zh: 回去的路上把试块送到检测实验室。

words.zh: 样品（取样）
words.definition: A small amount of material taken for testing; as a verb, to take it.

examples.en: Sample the aggregate from the stockpile, not the truck.
examples.zh: 从料堆取骨料样，不要从卡车上取。

words.zh: 符合性（是否符合规范）
words.definition: Whether the work meets the specification.

examples.en: We need a conformance report for each lot of basecourse.
examples.zh: 每批基层都需要一份符合性报告。

words.zh: 材料证明（出厂合格证）
words.definition: A document from a supplier showing a material, such as steel or pipe, meets its standard.

examples.en: Ask the supplier for the material certificates for the steel.
examples.zh: 向供应商要钢材的出厂证明。

words.zh: 合规（符合法规、许可或标准）
words.definition: Meeting the rules set by laws, consents, standards or contracts.

examples.en: Compliance with the consent conditions is checked every month.
examples.zh: 每个月都会检查是否遵守许可条件。

words.zh: 骨料（碎石、砂石的统称）
words.definition: Crushed rock, gravel and sand used in roads, concrete and drainage.

examples.en: The aggregate for the basecourse comes from the quarry up the valley.
examples.zh: 基层用的骨料来自山谷上面的采石场。

words.note: 作名词读 AG-rih-git；作动词“汇总”读 AG-rih-gayt，IT 报表里常见后者。

words.zh: 砾石（卵石）
words.definition: Small stones, either natural river stones or crushed rock.

examples.en: Put a layer of gravel round the subsoil drain.
examples.zh: 在盲沟周围铺一层砾石。

words.zh: 砂
words.definition: Fine grains of rock, used in concrete, pipe bedding and backfill.

examples.en: Bed the fibre duct in sand so nothing sharp touches it.
examples.zh: 光缆管用砂子垫层，别让尖东西碰到它。

words.zh: 碎石（机械破碎的石料）
words.definition: Rock broken into angular pieces in a crusher, which locks together well when compacted.

examples.en: Crushed rock compacts much better than round river gravel.
examples.zh: 碎石比圆滑的河卵石更容易压实。

words.zh: 石粉（碎石时产生的细料）
words.definition: The fine material left over from crushing rock, used as bedding and under pavers.

examples.en: Use crusher dust under the pavers, not sand.
examples.zh: 铺路砖下面用石粉，不要用砂。

words.zh: GAP65 级配碎石（最大65毫米的一般级配料）
words.definition: A New Zealand name for general all-passing crushed aggregate up to 65 mm, often used for sub-base and hardfill.

examples.en: Put GAP65 in the soft areas and AP40 on top.
examples.zh: 软的地方铺GAP65，上面再铺AP40。

words.note: GAP = general all passing，数字是最大粒径（毫米），也有 GAP40 等；比 AP 系列要求宽松，具体以规范为准。

words.zh: 排水碎石（粒径单一、透水的碎石）
words.definition: Clean, single-size gravel with no fines, so water can drain through it easily.

examples.en: Backfill behind the wall with drainage metal.
examples.zh: 挡墙后面用排水碎石回填。

words.note: metal 在新西兰指碎石料。

words.zh: 火山渣（多孔红黑色火山石）
words.definition: A light, porous volcanic rock, common in Auckland, used for drainage and fill.

examples.en: Auckland has a lot of scoria, which drains really well.
examples.zh: 奥克兰有很多火山渣，排水性很好。

words.zh: 杂砂岩（新西兰最常用的硬质石料）
words.definition: A hard, grey sandstone that is the most common source of road aggregate in much of New Zealand.

examples.en: Greywacke chips are hard-wearing, which is why they're used for sealing.
examples.zh: 杂砂岩碎石耐磨，所以用于封层。

words.zh: 封层碎石（撒在沥青上的单粒径石子）
words.definition: Single-size stone chips spread over sprayed bitumen to make a chip seal.

examples.en: The sealing chip has to be clean and dry or it won't stick.
examples.zh: 封层碎石必须干净干燥，否则粘不住。

words.zh: 石块（大块石料）
words.definition: Large stones used for protection, such as at outfalls, stream banks or seawalls.

examples.en: Place rock at the culvert outlet to stop scour.
examples.zh: 在涵洞出口放石块防冲刷。

words.note: 现场 rock 也可以指“岩层”：We hit rock at two metres（两米处挖到岩石）。

words.zh: 抛石护坡（防冲刷的大块石）
words.definition: Large rocks placed on a bank or around a structure to protect it from erosion by water.

examples.en: The riprap along the river bank washed out in the flood.
examples.zh: 河岸的抛石护坡在洪水中被冲走了。

words.zh: 黏土
words.definition: A fine, sticky soil that holds water and becomes very soft when wet.

examples.en: Clay is a nightmare to compact after rain.
examples.zh: 雨后黏土压实简直是噩梦。

words.zh: 淤泥（粉土，细小的沉积颗粒）
words.definition: Very fine soil particles, finer than sand, that wash easily into streams.

examples.en: The stream turned brown with silt from the site.
examples.zh: 工地的淤泥把小溪染成了褐色。

words.zh: 泥炭土（富含有机物的软土）
words.definition: Soft, dark soil made of partly rotted plants, which compresses a lot and is poor to build on.

examples.en: The peat under the road is why it keeps settling.
examples.zh: 路下面的泥炭土是它不断沉降的原因。

words.zh: 土工布
words.definition: A strong fabric laid in the ground to separate soil layers, filter water or add strength.

examples.en: Lay geotextile over the clay before the sub-base goes on.
examples.zh: 铺底基层之前在黏土上铺一层土工布。

words.note: 现场也叫 geofabric 或 cloth。

words.zh: 土工格栅（塑料网格加筋材料）
words.definition: A plastic grid laid in fill or under pavement to lock aggregate together and spread loads.

examples.en: The design has two layers of geogrid in the embankment.
examples.zh: 设计在路堤里放两层土工格栅。

words.zh: 沥青（黑色黏稠胶结料）
words.definition: The black, sticky binder made from crude oil that holds road surfaces together.

examples.en: The bitumen has to be hot enough when it's sprayed.
examples.zh: 喷洒时沥青温度必须足够高。

words.note: bitumen 是胶结料本身；asphalt 在新西兰多指沥青混凝土路面（美国 asphalt 也可指 bitumen）。

words.zh: 乳化沥青（沥青加水乳化）
words.definition: Bitumen mixed with water and an emulsifier so it can be sprayed cold.

examples.en: Use emulsion for the tack coat.
examples.zh: 粘层用乳化沥青。

words.zh: 木材（建筑用材）
words.definition: Wood cut and prepared for building, such as for formwork, retaining walls and fences.

examples.en: Order more timber for the boxing.
examples.zh: 再订一些做模板的木材。

words.note: NZ/英国说 timber；美国说 lumber。

words.zh: 防腐木（按用途等级处理过的木材）
words.definition: Timber treated with chemicals so it resists rot and insects; in New Zealand, graded by hazard class such as H3.2, H4 and H5.

examples.en: Retaining wall poles in the ground need a higher treatment class than fence rails.
examples.zh: 埋入地下的挡墙木柱需要比围栏横条更高的防腐等级。

words.note: 新西兰按 H 等级区分（数字越大越耐腐，用于越严苛的环境，如埋地、接触淡水等）；具体用哪个等级以设计为准。

words.zh: 辐射松（新西兰最常用的人工林木材）
words.definition: The fast-growing pine tree planted widely in New Zealand and used for most building timber.

examples.en: Most of the poles are treated radiata pine.
examples.zh: 大部分木柱都是经过防腐处理的辐射松。

words.zh: 结构钢
words.definition: Steel beams, columns and plates used to build bridges and other structures.

examples.en: The structural steel for the footbridge comes galvanised.
examples.zh: 人行桥的结构钢是镀锌的。

words.zh: 镀锌的（防锈处理）
words.definition: Coated with zinc to stop the steel from rusting.

examples.en: Use galvanised bolts on everything outside.
examples.zh: 室外所有地方都用镀锌螺栓。

words.note: NZ/英式拼写 galvanised；美式 galvanized。

words.zh: PVC管（聚氯乙烯）
words.definition: Polyvinyl chloride: a rigid plastic used for stormwater and wastewater pipes.

examples.en: The laterals are 100 mm PVC.
examples.zh: 支管是100毫米的PVC管。

words.zh: PE管（聚乙烯管）
words.definition: Flexible polyethylene pipe, used for water mains and services because it bends and is joined by welding.

examples.en: The new water main is PE, so it's all welded joints.
examples.zh: 新供水主管是PE管，所以全是焊接接头。

words.note: 常说 PE 或 poly pipe；大口径常用 HDPE。

words.zh: 混凝土管
words.definition: A strong precast pipe made of reinforced concrete, used for large stormwater pipes and culverts.

examples.en: The 1200 concrete pipes need a crane to lift them in.
examples.zh: 1200口径的混凝土管需要吊车吊入。

words.note: 常缩写 RCP（reinforced concrete pipe）。

words.zh: 球墨铸铁（管材）
words.definition: A strong, slightly flexible cast iron used for water mains and fittings.

examples.en: The bridge crossing is in ductile iron, not PE.
examples.zh: 过桥段用球墨铸铁管，不用PE管。

words.note: 常缩写 DI。

words.zh: 石灰（用于土壤稳定）
words.definition: A white powder made from limestone, mixed into wet clay to dry it out and make it stronger.

examples.en: Spread lime over the wet clay and mix it in.
examples.zh: 在湿黏土上撒石灰并拌匀。

words.zh: 沙袋
words.definition: A bag filled with sand, used to weigh down signs or hold back water.

examples.en: Put sandbags on the sign stands; it's going to blow tonight.
examples.zh: 在标志支架上压沙袋，今晚会刮大风。

words.zh: 再生混凝土骨料（破碎的旧混凝土）
words.definition: Old concrete broken up and reused as fill or sub-base.

examples.en: Can we use crushed concrete instead of quarry aggregate here?
examples.zh: 这里可以用破碎的再生混凝土代替采石场骨料吗？

words.zh: 采石场
words.definition: A place where rock is dug, blasted and crushed to make aggregate.

examples.en: The quarry is only 15 minutes away, so cartage is cheap.
examples.zh: 采石场只有15分钟车程，所以运费便宜。

words.zh: 塑料薄膜
words.definition: A thin plastic sheet used to cover stockpiles, protect concrete and stop moisture.

examples.en: Throw some polythene over the topsoil stockpile.
examples.zh: 在表土堆上盖块塑料布。

words.note: NZ/英国说 polythene；美国说 plastic sheeting。
